cf8cf37bde3f5175.description:
At Maersk, we’re transforming global supply chains through end-to-end integrated logistics. As a global leader in connecting and simplifying trade, we help businesses move goods seamlessly across ocean, air, landside transportation, and warehousing, all supported by cutting-edge technology and an extensive global network.

  

We’re committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, heard, and able to be themselves. Our team members come from a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we value the unique strengths each person contributes. With over 100,000 employees across 130 countries, we work together to shape the future of global trade and logistics.

  

**About the Role**
------------------

Maersk Oil Trading is looking for a Fuel Trader to join our New York trading team. In this global role, you will help secure reliable and cost-effective fuel supply for the Maersk fleet while supporting the continued development of our trading activities across the Americas.

You will have the opportunity to contribute across back-to-back bunker trading, physical cargo trading, and self-supply activities, depending on your experience and strengths. Working closely with traders, physical operators, risk, legal, Maersk Ocean, and our broader global Energy Markets organization, you will help manage traditional marine fuels as well as sustainable alternatives including biofuels, methanol, and LNG.

  

This is an opportunity to join a lean, collaborative team where you can take meaningful ownership, contribute ideas from your previous experience, and continue building your commercial and technical capabilities in an international trading environment.

  

**What We Offer**
-----------------

This is an exciting career opportunity to work in a truly international company that makes global trade happen. You will be interacting daily with passionate colleagues around the world, giving you the opportunity to develop your professional skills in a global environment. Through the training and support we provide and learning on the job, you will have the chance to truly take your career all the way.

* Join a global energy trading organization managing more than 12 million metric tonnes of fuel annually.
* Gain exposure to back-to-back trading, physical cargoes, storage, blending, barging, and self-supply activities.
* Work within a collaborative, open-office environment alongside trading, operations, risk, and legal professionals.
Build an international network across Maersk’s Energy Markets, Energy Transition, and Ocean organizations.  

  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Trade physical cargoes, including FOB, DAP, and CIF transactions, across low-sulphur fuels, high-sulphur fuels, biofuels, methanol, and LNG in the Americas.
* Execute back-to-back bunker transactions to support fuel demand across the Maersk fleet.
* Support self-supply activities, including cargo purchasing, storage, blending, quality management, and fuel delivery.

15c6c6712d2c950b.title: Sell Side Research Analyst
15c6c6712d2c950b.description:
**About Ornn**
--------------

Ornn is building the financial infrastructure for AI compute. Our price indices are live on Bloomberg Terminal. We structure and trade compute hedging instruments. And we're now building a platform that brings exchange-grade mechanics like order management, matching, scheduling, and settlement to how compute capacity gets reserved and allocated. We're a lean team in New York, backed by leading venture and strategic investors.

### **About the Role**

GPU compute is turning into an asset class, and almost nobody is writing about it with real data. You would be Ornn's first dedicated research analyst, publishing the work that hedge funds, consultancies, lenders and operators read to understand where compute prices are going and why.

You'll sit at the center of Ornn Data. Our index draws on more than 150 providers and roughly 1,000 transactions a day, and you'll turn that into research our clients pay for and our sales and markets teams use in every conversation.

### **What You'll Do**

* Publish regular research on the compute market: weekly pricing notes, monthly market reports, and deeper pieces on GPU generations, supply coming online, contract terms and residual values.
* Cover the companies that shape the market: hyperscalers, neoclouds, chipmakers, data center developers and their capex plans.
* Take calls with institutional clients, consultancies and lenders, and present at client meetings and industry events.
* Manage our freelance writers and researchers, set the research calendar and hold the bar on quality.

**Requirements**

* 1 to 4 years in equity or credit research, commodities research, or a research role at a fund, data provider or consultancy.
* Strong modeling skills in Excel and comfort working with large datasets.
* Clear, fast writing. You can turn a messy dataset into a sharp one-page view with a point of view.
* Real curiosity about AI infrastructure and how compute is bought, sold and financed.
* Comfortable working independently in a lean team.

**Nice-to-Haves**

* Sell side coverage of semiconductors, data centers, cloud or TMT.
* Experience with commodity markets, benchmarks or index products.
* Python or SQL.
* An existing following or published work in the AI infrastructure space.

### **Why This Role Matters**

A market only works when people trust the information about it. Ornn's index, futures work with ICE and data business all depend on being the most credible voice on what compute costs. This role is how that credibility shows up in the world every week, and how Ornn becomes the first place institutions go to understand the asset.

### **Compensation and Benefits**

Benefits include competitive salary, meaningful equity, health coverage, meals, and additional benefits.

### **Equal Opportunity Statement**

Ornn is committed to building a diverse team. We evaluate candidates based on their ability to do the work, not on pedigree or background. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds and experiences.

Compensation Range: $130K - $180K

**Title: Associate, CREF Large Loan - New York, NY**

  

**Global Banking and Markets**

Global Banking and Markets (GBM) is a leading Canadian Capital Markets and Investment Banking business with a growing platform in the U.S. and Latin America and a global presence spanning more than 100 years. Scotiabank’s strong U.S. platform provides clients with an important bridge to capital and investment flows across the Americas and globally.

  

GBM provides a broad range of investment banking, credit, capital markets and risk management products and services to support the financing and strategic needs of our clients. Our capabilities include debt and equity financing, mergers and acquisitions, corporate banking, fixed income, institutional equity sales and trading, research, derivatives, foreign exchange and other capital markets products.

  

**Overview**

Scotiabank’s Commercial Real Estate Finance (CREF) Large Loan team provides secured commercial real estate financing to institutional sponsors, including private equity firms, asset managers, REITs and other leading owners and investors in commercial real estate.

  

The team originates, structures, underwrites and executes large-balance commercial real estate financings, including balance sheet loans, note-on-note financings, and single-asset/single-borrower (SASB) CMBS loans.

  

The Associate will play an integral role across the full lifecycle of transactions, from initial opportunity evaluation and underwriting through credit approval, documentation, closing, and asset management. This role provides significant exposure to commercial real estate underwriting, structured lending, capital markets execution and institutional client coverage. This position will work closely with Capital Markets, Credit Risk Management, Loan Transaction Management, Securitization, Legal and Asset Management throughout the transaction lifecycle.

  

**What You’ll Do:**

* Support loan origination and client coverage efforts with institutional real estate owners, private equity firms, asset managers, REITs and other commercial real estate market participants.
* Evaluate and underwrite large-balance CRE financing opportunities across the major property types and transaction structures, including balance sheet, note-on-note financings, and SASB CMBS loans.
* Build and analyze detailed financial models, including property-level cash flows, valuation analyses, debt sizing, financing metrics and sensitivity analyses.
* Conduct comprehensive property, market, sponsor and structural analysis, including review of historical and projected operating performance, leases, third-party reports, market data and comparable transactions.
* Participate in structuring transactions and developing financing solutions that balance client objectives, transaction economics and the Bank’s risk parameters.
* Prepare credit approval materials, transaction memoranda and presentations for senior management and internal credit committees.
* Work closely with the Capital Markets and Securitization teams to evaluate financing strategy, market execution and distribution considerations for CMBS transactions.
* Coordinate transaction execution from underwriting through closing, including due diligence, third-party reports, credit approvals, legal documentation and closing requirements.
* Monitor existing transactions and portfolio exposures and assist in identifying and evaluating credit, market and execution risks.

  

**What You’ll Bring**

* Relevant experience in commercial real estate finance, investment banking, real estate private equity, commercial real estate lending, CMBS or a related field.
* Strong commercial real estate underwriting and financial modeling skills, including experience with property-level cash flows, valuation, debt sizing and sensitivity analysis.
* Analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify and communicate key credit and transaction risks.
* Attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple transactions and priorities simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to work collaboratively across internal teams and interact professionally with clients, advisors, legal counsel and other transaction counterparties.

**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

The Quantitative Trading & Research team develops quantitative models, algorithms, analytical capabilities and agentic workflows to help Cash Equities Sales teams engage more effectively with clients. By transforming complex client flow and transaction data, including trades, orders, axes and IOIs, into actionable signals, client-targeting insights, “who to call” recommendations, dynamic client content, trade ideas and post-trade opportunities, the team supports both inbound and outbound client workflows

**Job Summary**  
As an Associate in the Quantitative Trading & Research team, you will develop quantitative models, algorithms, analytical capabilities and agentic workflows that improve how Cash Equities Sales teams engage with clients. You will transform complex data, including client flow and transactional data such as trades, orders, axes and IOIs, into relevant signals, client targeting and "who to call" recommendations, LLM-generated dynamic client content, trade ideas and post-trade opportunities, supporting inbound and outbound client workflows. You will own the research lifecycle from problem framing and data preparation through methodology, evaluation, production implementation and monitoring, partnering with Technology, Data and Product on integration. You will use statistical methods, ML, LLMs and AI agents where they add value.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Research, develop and validate models and algorithms for data processing, signal identification, client targeting, opportunity prioritization and Sales analytics.
* Construct reproducible research datasets and develop methods for extracting, enriching and interpreting structured and unstructured data, including Cash Equities flow and transactional data (executions, orders, axes, IOIs, blocks).
* Analyze client trading behavior, including flow patterns, sector and stock preferences, position changes, liquidity needs and trading style, to identify which clients to target, with which ideas, and when.
* Develop "who to call" recommendation models that rank clients for Sales coverage by combining flow signals, axes and liquidity, trade ideas and market events, with a clear rationale for each recommendation.
* Build reusable executable analytical capabilities, including tools, skills and plugins, that encode research methods for use in Sales applications and AI-assisted workflows.
* Design, build and evaluate agentic workflows that orchestrate these tools, data services and models to automate multi-step Sales tasks, such as client pre-call briefings, flow summaries, idea-to-client matching and inbound request handling, with appropriate guardrails, human-in-the-loop review and auditability.
* Develop dynamic, data-derived client content grounded in analytical insights, with clear source attribution and supporting rationale, for outreach and responses to inbound requests.
* Use LLMs to generate personalized client content, such as talking points, flow commentary, trade idea summaries and outreach drafts, grounded in underlying data through retrieval, with controls for factual accuracy, hallucination, tone and compliance.
* Develop algorithms to generate trade ideas and identify post-trade opportunities using client positions, historical flow, objectives, product characteristics and market conditions, and match ideas, axes and liquidity to the most relevant clients.
* Design experiments and evaluation benchmarks, compare approaches against baselines, and use error analysis and Sales feedback to improve analytical quality and business impact, including the reliability, accuracy and usefulness of agent and LLM outputs, recommendation uptake and content quality.
* Implement and maintain production-quality analytical code, with testing, reproducibility, explainability and monitoring of model, agent and output performance.

**Required Qualifications**

* Strong Python and SQL skills, with experience developing modular, testable analytical software for production use.
* Strong quantitative foundations in probability, statistics, numerical methods, machine learning or related disciplines.
* Experience designing, implementing and evaluating models, algorithms or analytical techniques against real business problems.
* Hands-on experience working with complex datasets, including large-scale transactional or time-series data, data preparation, feature engineering, validation and reproducible analysis.
* Ability to design rigorous experiments, interpret results, diagnose failure modes and demonstrate measurable improvements.
* Advanced degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science, Physics, Engineering, Quantitative Finance or a related field.
* Ability to explain analytical methods, assumptions and trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Practical judgment and ownership of research delivery, with appropriate handling of confidential data and adherence to established risk and change controls.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Cash Equities, including client flow, execution data, axes/IOIs, block trading or market microstructure.
* Experience with client portfolios or positions, Sales analytics, or trade-lifecycle opportunities.
* Experience analyzing financial or time-series datasets to identify actionable signals.
* Experience developing "who to call", client targeting, recommendation or prioritization algorithms, or dynamic analytical client content with traceable sources.
* Experience applying ML or LLMs to data interpretation, retrieval, content generation or decision support, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), prompt design, evaluation and monitoring.
* Experience designing and evaluating agentic workflows (e.g. tool-calling agents, multi-step orchestration, planning and retrieval), including guardrails, evaluation harnesses and observability.
* Experience integrating analytical code into applications or AI agents through reusable tool

**Position Summary:**

In this role, the successful candidate is responsible for conducting independent basic science experimentation based on research conducted in the assigned laboratory under the mentorship of a senior scientist. Individual is expected to seek to build a portfolio of research accomplishments in preparation for acquiring a higher degree in biomedical research or medicine.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* After a period of time working in the laboratory, the candidate will be expected to train graduate students and post-doctoral fellows in experimental design, technique and performance.
* Generates hypotheses and designs and performs experiments to test them.

* Prepares figures and diagrams for presentations and publications.
* Communicates results and collaborates with other professionals in the lab.
* Demonstrates a significant level of intellectual input into the design of the project.
* Presents findings at lab meeting, responds to challenges, and participates in exchanges of ideas to advance the science.
* Reads and understands relevant scientific literature.

For further information about Morgan Stanley Investment Management, please visit www.morganstanley.com/im .

MSGI’s inaugural fund, North Haven Growth & Innovation (“NHGIF” or the “Fund”) closed on $1.3 billion of capital commitments in an oversubscribed offering in which Morgan Stanley, its affiliates, and employees collectively committed 24% of the Fund’s capital. **JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

The Center for Carbon Transition (CCT) serves as the firm's center of excellence on the low-carbon transition, helping clients and internal stakeholders navigate evolving decarbonization, energy, and sustainability opportunities and challenges. The CCT team leads the development and management of the firmwide portfolio-level carbon intensity targets, green financing goal, and Energy Supply Financing Ratio (ESFR) and related client engagement. In this role, the team provides transition insights for senior leadership and our banking partners and clients.

As an Analyst in the Center for Carbon Transition, you will use your experience to support the broader mandate of CCT in advising the firm on the energy transition outlook while building your own decarbonization / transition expertise and you will be a self-starter with a strong analytical/quantitative base and excellent attention to detail, working closely with the New York, Washington DC and London-based CCT team and interfacing with internal colleagues across the firm as well as with clients.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Support the development and implementation of the Firm's strategy to align, over time, its financing portfolio with net zero emissions by 2050
* Stay close to evolving client transition and decarbonization plans, translating developments into timely engagement opportunities
* Support client engagement (e.g., meetings, events, content), using transition insights to shape meeting objectives, attendee strategy, and next steps
* Support and own elements of quantitative client and portfolio carbon analytics, assessing carbon performance at both the individual transaction level and across industry portfolios

* Excellent analytical skills (including proficiency in Excel, working with large datasets and third-party data sources) and strong interpersonal skills
* Strong attention to detail and self-starter mindset
* Demonstrated interest in energy, climate and decarbonization themes

**Preferred qualifications**

* Demonstrated ability to independently structure and execute complex analytical workstreams, synthesize findings, and communicate actionable recommendations
* Subject matter expertise in key energy transition and decarbonization topics
* Understanding of banking products
* Understanding of carbon accounting concepts and practical application to corporates (scopes, boundaries, data limitations, and interpretability)

66f5d0742468b64b.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Portfolio construction sits at the heart of how J.P. Morgan delivers advice to clients, and the Office of Portfolio Construction (OPC) is the firm's strategic engine behind it. We're seeking an energetic, intellectually curious Analyst to join the Portfolio Construction Strategy team — the front-office arm of OPC — to help shape how advisors across the U.S. Private Bank and U.S. Wealth Management build, review, and refine client portfolios.

OPC is a major initiative for the business, with a mission to elevate portfolio construction as a core differentiator of the Private Bank and Wealth Management and equip advisors to build portfolios aligned to each client's plan, grounded in our principles, and focused on after-tax outcomes. The group is focused on three pillars — establishing portfolio construction principles, tying strategy to portfolio action, and providing advisors with customized guidance they can scale — and operates across the Private Bank and U.S. Wealth Management, supporting 7,000+ advisors and more than $750B in investment assets. Our north star is embedding our advice and methodologies into the AI-powered tools (ConnectWealth and Portfolio Builder) that scale portfolio advice across every advisor.

You'll work alongside senior Strategists and partner closely with Global Investment Strategy, Investments Research, Managed Investments, Due Diligence, and regional Investments & Advice leaders — gaining a broad, cross-asset view of how portfolios actually get built through an after-tax lens at one of the world's leading wealth managers.

**Our Team**

The Portfolio Construction Strategy team is the advisor-facing engine of OPC. We own the firm's portfolio construction philosophy, drive the content and education that bring it to life, and partner with every region and channel across the Private Bank and U.S. Wealth Management to drive adoption. Working with a product-agnostic lens — across public and private assets, taxable and tax-exempt portfolios, and discretionary, advisory and brokerage accounts — we help advisors answer the questions that matter most for client portfolios: how to build a strategic asset allocation, how to deliver on client preferences such as high income or concentrated-equity diversification, how to size high-conviction ideas alongside a core portfolio, and how to drive tax-efficiency across the whole portfolio.

**Job Responsibilities**

As an Analyst on the Portfolio Construction Strategy team, you'll work under the guidance of senior Portfolio Construction and Tax-Aware Strategists and the US Head of Portfolio Construction Strategy. You'll start by supporting the team's core workstreams and, over time, aim to grow into a Portfolio Construction Strategist in your own right. In this role, you will:

* Support the development and rollout of our flagship Portfolio Construction content — including the Portfolio Construction Philosophy, Portfolio Construction Themes decks, Implementation Guide, sizing guidance primers, 1-pagers, and portfolio checklists — ensuring every piece is accurate, consistent, and on-message with our views.
* Partner on strategic initiatives such as the Expanded/Custom Strategic Asset Allocation framework, Portfolio Templates, and Framework for Taxes in Portfolio Construction — from design through advisor rollout.
* Help embed OPC methodologies into AI-powered advisor tools (ConnectWealth, Portfolio Builder, Co-Pilot, Connect Coach), working with Research, Risk, and technology partners to translate our frameworks into scalable product features.
* Work on large, complex client and prospect situations, helping advisors analyze portfolios and deliver solutions that win and retain assets.
* Prepare materials for broad advisor forums such as USPB Morning Meetings, U.S. Wealth Management National Calls, advisor training sessions, and senior leadership forums — including slides, talking points, and follow-up communications.
* Track progress against the team's deliverables across USPB and USWM; coordinate with stakeholders in Global Investment Strategy, Investments Research, Managed Investments, Due Diligence, Portfolio Analytics, and regional Investments & Advice leadership to keep workstreams on plan.
* Build a deep, foundational understanding of capital markets, asset allocation, tax-aware investing, and multi-asset portfolio construction.
* Successful analysts will build a clear development track into a full Portfolio Construction Strategist seat on the team, developing cross-asset expertise spanning public equities and fixed income, private markets, hedge funds, structured products, and more — given the breadth of the team's remit.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills**

* 1–2 years of experience in wealth management, asset management, investment strategy, portfolio management, or another financial markets–related role.
* Genuine interest in financial markets, asset allocation, portfolio construction, and macro-level economics, with a strong willingness to learn and grow in these areas.
* Foundational understanding of taxes and how they influence portfolio decisions — including the impact on asset allocation and asset location — with an interest in deepening tax-aware investing expertise.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex portfolio and market concepts into clear, concise messages for advisors, senior leaders, and clients.
* Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with high proficiency in AI tools and comfort working with portfolio and performance data.
* Background in finance, economics, mathematics, statistics, or financial accounting;
* Exceptional organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities, workstreams, and stakeholders simultaneously with limited supervision.
* Strong business acumen and strategic thinking, with a demonstrated interest in driving organizational priorities and cross-functional initiatives.

**About Our Company**

  

Aflac Asset Management, LLC, (d.b.a. Aflac Global Investments) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Aflac Incorporated (Aflac). Aflac Global Investments (GI) located in New York’s financial district and is the organization responsible for the overall investment activities of Aflac, Inc. and subsidiaries in Japan, Bermuda, and the U.S. With 150 employees globally, GI seeks investments to maximize long-term returns with a focus on preservation of capital, subject to our asset-liability profile and liquidity and capital requirements. GI has primary investment and asset management responsibility for Aflac’s general account consisting of public, private, and growth assets (including strategic partnerships) which generates approximately $3.5 billion a year in net investment income. As of year-end 2024, Aflac’s total general account portfolio was approximately $100 billion.

  

The investment teams support GI’s overall goals and objectives by providing market insight and in-depth knowledge of assigned asset classes. GI oversees the strategic deployment of capital for life and supplemental health insurance company balance sheets utilizing both internal teams and external third party asset managers.

  

**Worker Designation** – This role is **hybrid**. This means you will be expected to report to one of our Aflac offices located in New York, New York for at least 60% of the work week. You will work from your home (within the continental US) for the remaining portion of the work week. Details of this schedule will be discussed with your leadership.

  

\*\*\* Housing Stipend provided for non local candidates.

  

**Program Overview**

This internship provides hands-on exposure to credit research within Aflac’s Global Investments organization. The intern will work closely with experienced analysts to understand how investment-grade portfolios are monitored, how credit risk is assessed, and how research supports portfolio management decisions. Through security-level and industry-focused analysis, the intern will gain insight into credit evaluation, financial statement review, and the role of research in maintaining portfolio quality within a long-term institutional investment framework.

Our summer interns participate in a series of activities that provide the opportunity to learn about all areas of the firm, as well as on-the job training in investments and analytics. • Assist analysts with research on specific securities and industries by gathering financial data, reviewing public disclosures, and summarizing key credit metrics.
  
• Contribute to internal credit analysis by helping prepare research materials, peer comparisons, and supporting documentation used in investment recommendations.
  
• Support ongoing portfolio surveillance efforts by helping track rating changes, credit events, and other risk indicators across covered holdings.

* Graduate-level student in finance, economics, or a related field.
* Foundational knowledge of accounting and financial statement analysis.

* Interest in credit research, fixed income markets, and investment analysis
* All candidates must have eligibility to work permanently in the U.S. and must be physically located in the continental U.S. for the duration of internship.
* Working time zone is Eastern Standard Time in New York City.
* Worker Designation: “hybrid work schedule – minimum of 3 days per week” and excited to have in-person learning for the summer

### **Please review the following job description:**

**Wholesale Client Coverage & Credit Summer Analyst Program**

**Position Summary**

The Wholesale Client Coverage & Credit Summer Analyst will join a 10-week program designed to build a practical foundation in commercial banking, credit analysis, risk assessment, and relationship management. Interns will combine structured learning with meaningful work on an assigned teams and a robust experience in one of several business areas designed to help them explore career paths across client coverage, credit, risk, and real estate within Wholesale Banking.

**What to Expect**

Over the course of this **10-week internship**, interns will start with one week of in-person training and then will complete a nine-week experience in one of the key business areas, including but not limited to Credit Analysis, Commercial Banking, Specialized Industries, Credit Risk and Portfolio Management, or Real Estate track.

Interns placed in a Real Estate rotation will gain targeted exposure to commercial real estate lending, underwriting, valuation fundamentals, market analysis, and portfolio management. They will learn how financing solutions are evaluated and structured across property types and client needs while developing an understanding of the distinct risks and considerations within commercial real estate.

Throughout the summer, interns will work alongside experienced professionals, contribute to team priorities, and build their understanding of financial analysis, borrower risk, client needs, transaction structure, and portfolio management. They’ll collaborate with teammates, develop analytical and professional skills, receive ongoing coaching and feedback, and apply what they've learned through a capstone project that addresses a real business or client need.

By the end of the program, they’ll have a broader understanding of the business, a stronger professional network, and valuable experience that can help prepare them for future opportunities in financial services. Upon successful completion of the summer internship, interns will be eligible to receive a full-time program analyst offer.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

Following is a summary of the essential functions for this job. Other duties may be performed, both major and minor, which are not mentioned below. Specific activities may change from time to time.

  

* Complete one week of in-person training focused on credit fundamentals, financial analysis, commercial banking, and the Wholesale Banking client and credit process.
* Complete a nine-week assignment in a business area such as Credit Analysis, Commercial Banking, Specialized Industries, Credit Risk and Portfolio Management, or Real Estate.
* Gather, organize, and analyze financial statements, borrower information, industry trends, market data, transaction information, and other materials under the guidance of experienced professionals.
* Assist with financial spreading, cash flow analysis, borrower and industry research, credit-review materials, portfolio monitoring, market analysis, or other work aligned with the assigned team.
* Support team priorities by preparing spreadsheets, presentations, written summaries, process documentation, and project updates that clearly communicate findings and open items.
* Learn how bankers and credit professionals evaluate client needs, borrower risk, repayment capacity, transaction structure, and ongoing portfolio performance.
* For a Real Estate assignment, support analysis of commercial real estate lending, valuation fundamentals, property and market information, transaction structure, and portfolio-management considerations.
* Collaborate with teammates and cross-functional partners, participate in meetings, ask informed questions, incorporate feedback, and provide timely updates on assigned work.
* Complete and present a capstone project that addresses a real business or client need and demonstrates financial analysis, problem solving, and communication skills.
* Participate in mentorship, networking, coaching, leader exposure, and professional-development activities throughout the internship.
* Follow applicable policies and procedures, exercise sound judgment, and protect confidential client and company information.

The hourly wage for this position is between $41 - $45 per hour.

**The Requirements**

* **Currently enrolled in a bachelor’s degree program with a graduation date of December 2027–June 2028**
* Overall GPA of 3.2 or above
* Strong analytical and financial aptitude
* Superior written and oral communication abilities
* Interest in commercial lending, credit analysis, risk management, relationship banking, or commercial real estate

7a0d5f1be857e5a8.description:
**Group Overview**

The TP ICAP Group is a world leading provider of market infrastructure.

  

Our purpose is to provide clients with access to global financial and commodities markets, improving price discovery, liquidity, and distribution of data, through responsible and innovative solutions.

  

Through our people and technology, we connect clients to superior liquidity and data solutions.

  

The Group is home to a stable of premium brands. Collectively, TP ICAP is the largest interdealer broker in the world by revenue, the number one Energy & Commodities broker in the world, the world’s leading provider of OTC data, and an award winning all-to-all trading platform.

  

Founded in London in 1866, the Group operates from more than 60 offices in 27 countries. We are 5,200 people strong. We work as one to achieve our vision of being the world’s most trusted, innovative, liquidity and data solutions specialist.

  
  

**Program Overview**

Our 10-week Global Broking Summer Internship offers a dynamic immersion into the world of institutional trading and operations. Interns gain hands-on exposure to the full trade lifecycle—from client onboarding to trade capture to settlement—while rotating across desks and asset classes within the world’s largest interdealer broker.

  

You’ll be part of a cohort of 10–15 Global Broking interns, joining a broader group of interns from across the organization. This structure fosters cross-functional learning and creates opportunities to build lasting professional relationships.

  

Program dates are Tuesday, June 1– Friday, August 6, 2027.

  

**Your Experience**

As a Global Broking intern, your summer will be shaped by real exposure to the business. You’ll spend your days embedded on active trading desks, learning directly from brokers and product specialists across a range of asset classes, including Fixed Income, FX & MM, Equities, Derivatives, and Emerging Markets.

  

Your day-to-day will include:

  

* Shadowing brokers during live trade execution; observing institutional price discovery in interdealer markets.

* Working on a summer-long capstone project in a small group, guided by a senior mentor, culminating in a final presentation to our C-Suite and other stakeholders.

* Practicing on student Bloomberg terminals to build fluency with market data and trading tools.

* Contributing to desk-specific mini-projects that reflect each product’s unique focus.

* Collaborating with peers on group initiatives and intern-led tasks.

* Exploring other functions across the firm—from operations and compliance to post-trade services.

* Participating in regular check-ins with the program coordinator for feedback and guidance.
  

**Culture, Programming & Mentorship**

We aim to create a summer experience that’s both professionally enriching and genuinely fun. Beyond the desk, interns participate in a minimum of three structured sessions per week, including:

  

* Learning & Development Workshops

* Volunteer and Community Engagement Events

Social and Networking Activities  

  

Each intern is matched with a dedicated one-on-one mentor to support their development throughout the program. These mentors offer career advice, help navigate the firm, and serve as sounding boards for questions and ideas.

  

Capstone groups are also paired with senior leaders who provide strategic guidance throughout the project.

  

**Eligibility Criteria**

To be considered, candidates must

* Be currently enrolled in an undergraduate program and pursuing a bachelor’s degree

* Have an anticipated graduation date of Spring 2028

* Be authorized to work in the United States (we do not offer visa sponsorship)

* Relocate at own cost if applicable; TP ICAP does not provide relocation or housing assistance
  

Ideal candidates are

* Curious and eager to learn, with a genuine interest in financial markets

* Adaptable and composed under pressure, with a willingness to take initiative

* Strong communicators who can listen, ask questions, and build relationships

* Collaborative team players who thrive in fast-paced environments

* Organized and able to manage multiple tasks with attention to detail

* Comfortable with light technical skills, including Microsoft Office Suite (especially Excel: VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, etc.)

If you're ready to grow your professional network while exploring the inner workings of global financial markets, we encourage you to apply now!

  

$34/hr

Fanatics Collectibles is a global product and technology company dedicated to redefining the world of collectibles. Through iconic brands like Topps, we create innovative physical and digital products that connect fans and collectors to the sports, entertainment, and culture they love.

Backed by Fanatics, the world's leading sports merchandise and collectibles company, we operate with the speed and creativity of a startup while leveraging unmatched scale, partnerships, and licensing relationships. Our teams collaborate across product, creative, operations, marketing, and licensing to deliver best-in-class collectibles to fans around the world.

* **Support Approvals & Documentation:** Track product approvals, assist with licensor communications, and maintain accurate product documentation and presentation materials.

### **Description**

Energy Aspects has an exciting, newly created opportunity for a Power Analyst to join our growing North American research team, based in New York. The successful candidate will have experience analysing and communicating views on US power markets, backed by strong data analysis, writing and presentation skills.

You will need to have strong data analysis skills and will work in a combination of excel and Python. You will assist in running, and enhancing, our in-house power market modelling tools but this role is not purely data science as you will be expected to produce written research on changes to the US electricity system and how these impact power market prices. This is a client facing role and you will be expected to have the ability to present your work clearly and communicate effectively with clients at all levels.

Our clients value our forecasts and market views and our analytical work is focused on creating forward looking views backed by data. Ideally, you will have experience in forecasting methods, timeseries analysis, statistics and energy economics and we will help you develop these skills further.

This position will require flexibility and the drive to go beyond the core hours when needed, ensuring we all fulfil our goals. All team members are encouraged to build their professional reputation within the industry. You must be able to work independently, as well as be capable of planning and prioritising to achieve success. In exchange, we offer excellent remuneration, a high-performance culture and challenging and exciting work.

Our team has a deep intellectual curiosity for the power system and energy markets, and the policy and technology changes that are driving it. To be part of this team you will need to demonstrate this too.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Writing analytical pieces focusing on wholesale power prices, demand for electricity and thermal generating fuels, and the buildout of generating capacity, all through the lens of a changing regulatory landscape.
* Developing visualisations, analysing data and enhancing models using excel, Python and our AI tools.
* Continuously seeking to increase your market knowledge and widen your network of contacts.
* Running scenarios on our in-house power model for North America, monitoring and maintaining assumptions and outputs and assisting in development of enhancements.
* Tracking developments in the US power markets, including capacity buildouts, load growth and regulatory and policy changes.
* Presenting EA’s forward-looking views on the power markets to clients and prospects.
* Continuously improving the quality of the power team data and processes.

* Deep intellectual curiosity about power markets.

* Strong data analysis skills, including the ability to use AI tools appropriately and with discernment.
* Strong written and oral communication skills.
* Ability to communicate data and conclusions effectively.
* Ability to think through problems logically and think outside the box to solve problems with limited data.
* Strong excel skills.
* Python coding skills.
* Self-starting, energetic and positive.
* Experience in analysing the North American electricity system and wholesale power markets.
* Some experience in writing reports and presenting views.
* The right to live and work in the United States.

Our office spaces are thoughtfully equipped to enhance your day-to-day experience whether working independently or collaborating with teammates. Enjoy the simple pleasures of a freshly brewed coffee, healthy snacks, and a social space for celebratory moments. One of the unique traits of life at Energy Aspects is the way our international colleagues often delight us with treats from around the globe. It’s safe to say you’ll never go hungry in our offices!

We recognize your contribution with a competitive compensation package that includes annual bonuses, comprehensive private health insurance, and substantial pension contributions. Additionally, we offer company share options, subsidized gym memberships, and a generous holiday policy to support your financial and personal well-being.

Join a company that values your professional growth and personal fulfilment, all within a supportive and engaging environment.

  

### **About Energy Aspects**

Founded in 2012, we are an independent research consultancy that has enjoyed phenomenal growth since our inception, and we have very ambitious plans to continue our upwards growth trajectory. We are passionately committed to providing indispensable and industry-leading short, medium and long-term analysis, and forecasts of the energy markets, that helps our clients trade, invest, finance and plan.

**Job Title - Advanced Specialist, Corporate Development**

Description - Help shape and execute Pearson’s acquisitions, divestitures and corporate joint ventures, combining financial analysis with hands-on deal delivery in a small, high-profile Corporate Development team. **Also known in the market as: Corporate Development Senior Analyst; Corporate Development Associate; M&A Analyst; M&A Associate; Investment Banking Associate.**

**About the Role**

Pearson helps people realize the life they imagine through learning. We are looking for an Advanced Specialist, Corporate Development to support transactions and corporate finance projects across our global business.

Reporting to the Team Manager, Corporate Development, you will join a flat team and work with colleagues across Corporate Development, Finance and our business units. You will help drive day-to-day transaction activity, from evaluating an opportunity and coordinating due diligence to preparing clear recommendations and supporting execution.

This is an opportunity to bring an existing foundation in transactions and financial modeling into an in-house role with broad exposure. You will learn Pearson’s businesses and education markets while contributing to live deal work and developing your M&A skills alongside senior colleagues.

**What You’ll Do**

* Evaluate potential acquisitions, divestitures and corporate joint ventures with business units, assessing the strategic case and commercial implications.
* Build and review financial models, valuations and returns analysis with business-unit and Finance partners.
* Coordinate due diligence and carve-out processes, keeping internal teams informed and ensuring they receive the information they need.
* Analyze deal information and risks, solve transaction problems and help drive projects toward completion.
* Prepare business cases and approval papers for senior management, CEO/CFO review and, where required, the Pearson Board.
* Support the review and negotiation of contracts and legal agreements, and represent Pearson in counterparty meetings.
* Help appoint and manage external advisors, including lawyers, investment bankers and due diligence providers.
* Contribute to strategic and corporate finance analysis, including defense and activism planning, balance sheet strategy, dividends and share buybacks.

* Relevant experience (minimum 3-5 years) in investment banking, M&A advisory, corporate finance or strategy at a large accounting or consulting firm, or M&A/strategy within a multinational company.
* An undergraduate degree in a relevant field, ideally business, finance or accounting.
* Financial modeling and valuation experience, including interpreting statutory and management accounts.
* Experience driving M&A transaction execution, with clear examples of your personal contribution.
* Strong analytical and business problem-solving skills, applying financial analysis to commercial issues.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including simplifying complex information and establishing credibility with senior leaders.
* Project management skills and the ability to manage several priorities with close attention to detail.
* Initiative, a results-focused work ethic and a reliable, collaborative approach.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

3f7354da9c5fae86.description:
#### **Role Overview**

Delta Capita is seeking a highly motivated Analyst to join our Post Trade Services team, supporting a Tier 1 global investment bank. This role offers an excellent opportunity for an early-career professional to gain exposure to custody, cash, payments, and securities services within a complex global banking environment.

The successful candidate will support strategic initiatives, vendor and banking relationship management, operational service oversight, and market infrastructure activities. Working closely with senior stakeholders across Operations, Treasury, Securities Services, and external financial institutions, the role provides broad exposure to the post-trade ecosystem and the opportunity to contribute to key business and regulatory initiatives.

#### **Key Responsibilities**

* Support business strategy initiatives including market assessments, new product evaluations, and analysis of banking capabilities across global markets.
* Assist with Request for Proposal (RFP) processes, banking partner evaluations, service provider selection exercises, and network footprint optimization projects.
* Prepare presentations, management information, and briefing materials for senior governance forums, relationship reviews, and strategic decision-making committees.
* Conduct analysis to support industry working groups, market infrastructure developments, and regulatory change initiatives.
* Develop and maintain a strong understanding of custody, cash management, payments, and securities services products.
* Support the review of post-trade operating models and service arrangements across the trade lifecycle.
* Monitor service performance and coordinate with Operations teams and external providers to investigate and resolve operational issues.
* Perform analysis of complex datasets to identify trends, risks, service improvement opportunities, and cost optimization initiatives.
* Build effective relationships with internal stakeholders and external banking partners to support ongoing service delivery and change programs.
* Contribute to risk management, control, and regulatory compliance activities, ensuring adherence to applicable policies and standards.

#### **Key Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business, or a related discipline.
* 1-2 years of experience within banking, custody, treasury, securities services, financial markets, or a related financial services environment.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex datasets and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including data analysis, reporting, and modelling.
* Strong PowerPoint and presentation development skills.
* Understanding of custody, cash management, payments, securities services, or post-trade operations is desirable.
* Knowledge of banking and regulatory frameworks, including KYC, client asset protection requirements, and operational risk controls, is advantageous.
* Experience working with external financial institutions, custodians, correspondent banks, or third-party vendors is preferred.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to engage effectively across multiple functions.
* Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to manage competing priorities.
* Demonstrated ownership, accountability, and a proactive approach to problem-solving.
* Adaptable and resilient, with the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced global environment and remain calm under pressure.

**Salary Range: $65,000-$75,000**

**Expectations Regarding Hybrid Working:**

As we are a Service Provider and Consulting firm servicing clients, our policy on physically working from the office (which may be the client’s offices or our own offices depending on the client) aligns to what our client’s policies and expectations are and these vary. Most of our clients now require a minimum of 3 days per week in the office, 2 days from home, and accordingly, this is also the minimum expectation that Delta Capita requires. However, some of our clients have now moved up to 4 or even 5 days in the office and we require candidates to be flexible to meet our clients’ demands.

**How We Work:**

Delta Capita is an equal opportunity employer. We positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of age, color, disability, national origin, ancestry, race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. If you require any reasonable adjustments through your interview process, please use the designated space within the application questionnaire.

As the selection and interview process is ongoing, please submit your application in English as soon as possible. If your profile is selected, a member of our team will contact you. For this role a valid work authorization for the US is mandatory.

**Who We Are:**

Delta Capita Group (a member of the Prytek Group) is a global managed services, consulting and solutions provider with a unique combination of experience in Financial Services and technology innovation capability. Our mission is to reinvent the financial services value chain providing technology based mutualized services for financial institutions for non-differentiating services.

c63236e115f32d93.title: Analyst / Associate, PE Secondaries Investment
c63236e115f32d93.description:
Pantheon has been at the forefront of private markets investing for more than 40 years, earning a reputation for an innovative approach to investing in secondaries, co-investments, and primary fund investments, as well as capital formation across commingled funds, evergreen vehicles and customized solutions. Our specialist investment capabilities span multiple strategies across private equity, infrastructure and real assets, and private credit. Through our collaborative and committed culture, we find new ways to solve complex problems together and deliver innovative investment opportunities across private markets. Pantheon currently manages approximately $82.3 billion in AUM across all its strategies, serving more than 750 institutional and 638 private wealth clients worldwide

For further details please visit www.pantheon.com

**Purpose of Position**

We are seeking a private equity investment professional to join the US Secondaries Investment Team, based in New York. The individual will execute private equity secondary transactions alongside senior members of the team.

We are looking for someone from either an investment banking role (e.g., private capital advisory group or regular M&A), a direct investing role, or a reputable secondaries firm, who has strong business acumen and financial modelling capabilities. The role would be split 50/50 between GP-led and LP-led transactions. On the GP-led side, investment opportunities would include diligencing, underwriting, and executing single-asset or multi-asset continuation vehicles across the US private equity market. This will require a similar level of due diligence as direct buyout or co-investment opportunities. The individual will also execute traditional LP stake transactions and will be able to leverage Pantheon’s longstanding relationships across the Primary and Co-investment platforms.

We have a preference for an experienced Analyst / Associate-level candidate with prior investing or investment banking experience, and are flexible on start date. A merit-based career track opportunity is available to candidates who demonstrate exceptional ownership, high competency, and strong problem-solving and communication skills.

**Key Responsibilities:**

The successful candidate is expected to assume the following key responsibilities, plus any other reasonable duties as required:

* Leading the diligence and financial modelling of private equity secondary investment opportunities, including managing the flow of diligence materials received, helping lead diligence meetings, preparing investment memoranda, and presenting opportunities to the Secondary Investment Committee
* Coordinating closely with senior team members on deal negotiations and transaction completion
* Monitoring the evolution and performance of completed transactions, as well as selected brand-name buyout funds across the US private equity market
* Supporting other secondaries business development, including origination initiatives and engaging with clients
* Ensuring compliance with relevant laws, regulations, and Pantheon policy

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Prior financial analysis and valuation modelling experience required, preferably within an investment bank or an investment firm
* Ability to assess and synthesise the merits and risks of an investment in an insightful manner and develop and execute appropriate diligence plans to address key considerations
* Ability to work in a collaborative, global team, including virtually across offices (e.g., SF, NY, London) and across the Pantheon platform (Primaries, Co-investment, Private Credit, Infrastructure)
* Ability to work to tight, transaction-driven deadlines with minimal supervision and manage workloads efficiently
* Outstanding quantitative, problem-solving, and communication skills, including mastery of Excel and PowerPoint (financial modelling and investment memoranda) and the ability to engage credibly with key stakeholders (GPs, intermediaries, portfolio company executives, clients, and senior internal stakeholders)
* Strong ownership mentality and entrepreneurial mindset, with the ability to take initiative, improve processes, and drive workstreams independently in a fast-paced, deal-driven environment
* Familiarity with applying AI and data-science tools to enhance transaction evaluation and diligence efficiency is a plus
* High level of professionalism, confidentiality, and discretion

**Expected base salary range:** USD 115,000 - 135,000

Actual base salary is determined by a range of factors including individual experience, skills and qualifications.

In addition to the above salary, Pantheon offers a generous employee benefits package, and successful candidates are eligible to receive a discretionary bonus

**This job description is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities, or requirements. You may be required to perform other job-related duties as reasonably requested by your manager.**

**Pantheon is an Equal Opportunities employer, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't perfectly align we'd still encourage you to apply.**

**Company Description**

**WHO WE ARE**

*fresh* is a global skincare brand within the LVMH Group, headquartered in New York City. We emphasize the look, feel, and scent in every product, transforming skincare into an elevated, sensual experience. Our collection of skincare, lip care, bodycare, and fragrances are available in 16 countries, across our fresh boutiques and digital channels, specialty and department stores, and more.

We are an organization of curious creators who embrace innovation, optimism, and always keep our customers at the forefront. With a pioneering spirit, we are empowered to challenge the status quo and use our authentic voice to do the right thing for our people, our brand, and the environment.

Here at *fresh*, we intentionally foster a spirit of belonging. We celebrate our diversity and support every employee to feel welcomed, valued, respected, and heard. By embracing curiosity and collaboration, we recognize that our differences strengthen us.

**MAIN JOB OBJECTIVE**

The Analyst, Global Forecasting, plays a crucial role in providing accurate and insightful data to support strategic business decisions. This position is responsible for the development, maintenance, and publication of comprehensive forecasting reports, ensuring key stakeholders have access to timely and reliable information regarding sales performance and demand planning. The ideal candidate possesses a strong analytical mindset, exceptional organizational skills, and a proven ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable reports. They will report directly to the Director, HQ Forecasting.

 **Job Description**

**JOB RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Collaborate with the forecasting team to design, develop, and implement weekly and monthly forecasting reports for various business units and regions.
* Prepare and publish comprehensive reports covering "Sell In" and "Sell Out" performance at both market and retailer levels.
* Monitor, analyze, and report on key performance indicators (KPIs), providing data-driven recommendations for process optimization and forecast accuracy improvement.
* Maintain and manage global Demand Planning Masterdata, ensuring data integrity, accuracy, and alignment across Supply Chain, Marketing, and Sales departments.
* Identify trends, anomalies, and variances in forecasting data and communicate potential impacts to relevant stakeholders.
* Automate reporting processes where possible to enhance efficiency and reduce manual effort.
* Participate in cross-functional projects related to forecasting model enhancements, data integration, and reporting tools.
* Support ad-hoc reporting and analysis requests from senior management and other departments

What you will learn in the first 6 months:

* Global understanding of Fresh strategy and portfolio
* Develop global knowledge and fresh strategy & approaches in a diversified, dynamic and highly competitive environment
* Develop expertise on our forecasting tool (DynaSys)
* Develop expertise on PBI
* Enhance database reporting

What you will achieve in 12 months:

* Continue to improve existing reporting and tool to sustain Fresh growth
* Create dashboards
* Issue weekly and monthly reporting
* Maintain the Forecasting Databases

**Physical Requirements:**

* Must be able to remain in a stationary position on average of 7.5 hours/day.
* Light to moderate lifting may be required.
* While performing the duties of this job, the employee may be regularly required to stand, sit, reach, stoop, kneel, and operate a computer, telephone, and keyboard.

  
**Qualifications**

**PROFILE**

* You can/have 1-4+ Years of Experience in data analysis, forecasting, reporting, or a similar function
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel (advanced skills required), including pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, conditional formatting, and complex formulas.
* Experience with business intelligence tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, QlikView) and/or forecasting software is a plus.
* Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills with an ability to interpret complex data and present findings clearly.
* Exceptional organizational skills and meticulous attention to detail.
* Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey technical information to non-technical audiences.
* A proactive, solution-oriented approach to challenges and a commitment to continuous improvement.
* Familiarity with master data management principles is desirable.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Statistics, Supply Chain Management, or a related quantitative field.

  
**Additional Information**

**WHAT WE OFFER YOU**

**Training & Development and Culture**

* Fresh and LVMH Sponsored Trainings and Workshops for Personal and Professional Development
* Opportunities for networking and building relationships with LVMH Community and Network
* Opportunities to join internal communities: DEIB Council, Sustainability Champions, LVMH Employee Resource Groups

**Mental Health Support**

* Free professional consultation, referrals and counseling through the Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Free 24/7 confidential mental health support

**Paid Time Off and Flexibility**

* Flexible paid time off policy inclusive of Summer Fridays

**Fertility and Family Planning**

* Fertility Services, Maternity and Newborn Support, Adoption and Surrogacy Assistance, including cryopreservation when part of fertility treatment
* Paid Parental Leave (Inclusive of Maternity, Paternity, Adoption, Surrogacy) at eligibility
* Travel & lodging for those who can’t access care
* Back-up dependent Care and Tutoring

**Fresh and LVMH ‘Perks’ and Discounts**

* Fresh In-Store Discounts and Gratis
* LVMH Group Friends and Family Sales across all divisions within LVMH: Wines and Spirits, Watches and Jewelry, Perfumes and Cosmetics, Fashion and Leather Goods, etc.
* Pre-Tax

**Analyst, Surveys**

**About AlphaSights:**

We bring together some of the most ambitious people from around the globe to work with the leading investment funds, strategy consultancies and Fortune 500 companies. Together, we help our clients access expert knowledge, elevate their decision-making and drive progress by connecting them with niche experts across the world.

Founded in 2008, our journey has been nothing short of extraordinary. With 2000 professionals in eight cities worldwide, we've firmly earned our place as a leader in our market and one of the fastest-growing companies in the world. Our relentless pursuit of excellence means we only hire the best and brightest graduates to help us reach new heights.

**The Role:**

As an Analyst on the Surveys team, you will play a key role in enabling AlphaSights' clients to collect expert insights through online, programmed surveys. As our Client Service team's quality gatekeeper and technical resource, you will ensure survey integrity throughout the delivery lifecycle, audit programmed surveys, and strengthen internal capabilities through training and technical support.

This is a chance to utilize and develop your skills in problem solving, attention to detail, and communication to help AlphaSights' survey project managers solve client pain points and unlock advanced survey capabilities, and in turn, help AlphaSights clients succeed. You will be based in New York and will support our global Surveys teams.

This is an excellent opportunity for motivated and hardworking professionals, who want to develop a highly transferable skill set in a client-centric environment.

**What you'll do:**

* **Quality control:** Partner with Client Service Managers and Associates to provide advanced quality assurance across survey drafting, programming and visualization, including troubleshooting bugs, optimizing survey flow, and comprehensive auditing.
* **Survey programming & advanced capabilities:** Troubleshoot complex survey programming and coding requests, support team members in resolving advanced cases, and help expand our ability to deliver sophisticated research methodologies (e.g., pricing questions).
* **Support live stakeholder requests:** Partner with cross-functional teams and senior team members to drive process optimizations and improved survey offerings.
* **Training:** Own technical training for the team, upskilling team members on best practices across survey drafting & design, quality control, and visualization.

  

**Who you are:**

* **Entry-level role**: 0-2 years of working experience. Relevant work/internship experience in a technical role in a business context is preferred
* **Excellent analytical and quantitative skills:** You enjoy technical challenges and have an innate desire to solve business problems analytically, also evidenced by holding a 3.5 GPA or above in a quantitative degree (e.g., Engineering, Math, Economics, Finance)
* **Meticulous:** You hold yourself to high standards, have obsessive attention to detail and take a methodical approach to work
* **Great problem solver:** You have an aptitude for solving complex and unstructured problems
* **Comfortable with ambiguity and high level of autonomy:** You're able to context switch effectively between various responsibilities and stakeholders, and can drive forward your work independently. This is a newer role and will require a proactive and autonomous mindset
* **Highly driven and proactive:** You have excellent planning and organizational skills, can meet tight deadlines and prioritize workloads in a fast-paced environment
* **Effective communicator**: You have excellent written, verbal, presentation and interpersonal skills; can clearly articulate your points and absorb feedback from both technical and non-technical stakeholders

**Technical skills:**

* Proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint
* Familiarity with coding (SQL, Python, R, VBA etc.) is a plus
* Familiarity with survey platforms (Decipher, Qualtrics, etc.) is a plus
* Must pass a quantitative based test for application to be progressed

**Compensation and benefits:**

* Annual base salary is $85,000
* 17 vacation days, in addition to 10 public holidays, and an end of year break between Christmas Day and New Year's Day
* Competitive medical, dental, and vision insurance

* **New York:** Prime midtown office with state-of-the-art amenities; option to WFH each Friday

Locations: **New York, New York**

  

**Job description**
-------------------

**About this role**

Company: BlackRock Financial Management, Inc.

Job Title: Associate

Location: 50 Hudson Yards, New York, NY 10001

Job Duties: Work on the implementation and maintenance of the model surveillance and performance monitoring infrastructure for the models supported by Single Security Pricing (SSP). Enhance the model documentation. Collaborate with the Risk & Quantitative Analysis (RQA) Group in model validation process for the models owned by SSP. Expand product and market coverage to address evolving client needs by researching, implementing and rolling out new models and analytics. Maintain and enhance existing interest rate, inflation, FX, synthetic credit and equity derivatives models. Refactor existing analytical code to make it more modular and scalable. Keep abreast of recent trends in technology, quantitative finance, capital markets and regulation. Bring the latest techniques to bear on the problems we face in our day-to-day work.

Qualifications: Master’s degree in Financial Engineering, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field and two (2) years of experience in the job offered or as an Analyst, Financial Engineer, or related role. Must have two (2) years of experience with: Experience programming in Python, R, MATLAB, SQL for quantitative analysis, and using Bloomberg terminal and Aladdin suite; and Experience applying time-series analysis to derivatives modeling, including historical volatility estimation, GARCH models, PCA on yield curve dynamics, and mean-reversion parameter estimation. Must have one (1) year of experience with: Experience with model validation and performance monitoring metric design, including validation metric design, out-of-sample testing, parameter stability assessment, threshold analysis, residual analysis, rolling-window statistical diagnostics, structural break detection, technical documentation of methodology and assumptions, and remediation of model review findings; Experience pricing fixed income derivatives including swaps, swaptions, caps/floors, CMS and CMS spread options, callable and puttable bonds; Experience implementing and calibrating short-rate models, including Hull-White, Shifted Lognormal, and G2++; Experience constructing and calibrating interest rate volatility surfaces including caplet stripping, swaption matrix fitting, and SABR smile calibration; Experience constructing multiple yield curves, including OIS, LIBOR & Bank, treasury curve; Experience pricing interest rate derivatives using LIBOR market model, SABR-LMM stochastic vol extension, and forward market model; Experience pricing convertible bonds and equity-credit hybrid securities using jump-diffusion PDE; Experience applying stochastic calculus to derivatives pricing including Ito's lemma, change of numeraire, Girsanov theorem, and Feynman-Kac representations; Experience implementing numerical methods including Crank-Nicolson finite difference, trinomial trees, Longstaff-Schwartz American Monte Carlo, and variance reduction; and Experience developing production pricing analytics in C++ including pricing libraries, calibration routines, and bond/derivative pricing engines.

To apply, please click “Apply” on this webpage.

For New York, NY Only the salary range for this position is USD$145,500.00 - USD$170,000.00 . Additionally, employees are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, and benefits including healthcare, leave benefits, and retirement benefits. BlackRock operates a pay-for-performance compensation philosophy and your total compensation may vary based on role, location, and firm, department and individual performance.

**Our benefits**
  
  
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

**Our hybrid work model**

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.

  

**Guidance on AI use for candidates**

  

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided **guidance** (opens in new window) on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.

  

**About BlackRock**

  
  

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.

  
  

This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees.
