6a88eaa39b52fc0a.description:
Blackstone is the world’s largest alternative asset manager. Blackstone seeks to deliver compelling returns for institutional and individual investors by strengthening the companies in which the firm invests. Blackstone’s over $1.3 trillion in assets under management include global investment strategies focused on real estate, private equity, credit, infrastructure, life sciences, growth equity, secondaries and hedge funds. Further information is available at www.blackstone.com. Follow @blackstone on LinkedIn, X (Twitter), and Instagram.

**Foundation Overview:**

With a commitment to advancing career and economic mobility, the Blackstone Charitable Foundation leverages its financial and human capital to expand access to opportunity and strengthen communities. Blackstone LaunchPad helps first-generation and low-income college students across the United States launch successful careers through professional development and access to paid internships at Blackstone, our portfolio companies and select startups. Blackstone Skilled Futures, launched in 2025, aims to increase access to high-quality training and employment opportunities in skilled trades, including construction and advanced manufacturing. The program supports student scholarships, institutional capacity building and other initiatives that strengthen the skilled trades talent pipeline. Blackstone Connects is our global employee engagement program, providing opportunities for Blackstone employees to support their local communities through volunteering and giving. Through Blackstone Connects, we support nonprofits and engage employees across our 27 global offices. Nearly 90% of employees participated in firm-sponsored charitable activities in 2025.

**Role Overview:**

Blackstone is seeking an Analyst to provide programmatic, operational and project-based support across the Blackstone Charitable Foundation. This generalist role will work across the Foundation’s portfolio, supporting program execution, nonprofit and partner engagement, communications, data and reporting, events and team operations. The Analyst will help manage day-to-day execution while also contributing to projects that strengthen how the Foundation operates and delivers its programs. The ideal candidate is a highly organized, proactive self-starter who can manage multiple priorities, communicate effectively with a range of stakeholders, learn quickly and take ownership of projects from planning through execution.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

**Events & Program Execution**

* Support the planning and execution of BXCF programs, events and special projects across BX Connects, LaunchPad, Skilled Futures, and BX Impact.
* Manage project plans, timelines and logistics, including registration, materials, communications, vendors, and day-of- execution.
* Coordinate with nonprofit partners, portfolio companies, program providers and internal stakeholders to manage deliverables, commitments and follow-up.

**Data, Reporting & Communications**

* Maintain high-quality program and participation data and support KPIs, dashboards, impact measurement and annual reporting.
* Analyze and synthesize program data, research and other information into clear insights, presentations, briefing materials and recommendations.
* Draft and edit program communications and maintain organized documentation, templates and resources across BXCF systems.

**Research, Projects & Team Operations**

* Conduct research and benchmarking to inform program design, partnerships, grantmaking and new initiatives across BXCF priorities.

* Support team planning and operations, including program calendars, trackers, meeting materials, and follow-up.
* Own cross-functional projects and evolving priorities that strengthen BXCF programs and operations as assigned.

**Candidate Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree required.
* 1+ years of professional experience; prior nonprofit or philanthropic experience is not required.
* Highly motivated, intellectually curious and eager to learn, with a demonstrated record of excellence and sound judgment.
* Exceptional organization, efficiency and attention to detail, manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Proactive and resourceful self-starter who anticipates needs, takes ownership and drives work through completion.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, work effectively across a range of internal and external stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint and comfort working with data.
* Adaptable and willing to roll up their sleeves across a broad range of responsibilities, quickly learn and leverage new systems and technology.

The duties and responsibilities described here are not exhaustive and additional assignments, duties, or responsibilities may be required of this position. Assignments, duties, and responsibilities may be changed at any time, with or without notice, by Blackstone in its sole discretion.

$85,000 - $115,000

**About Invesco**
=================

As one of the world’s leading independent global investment firms, Invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. By delivering the combined power of our distinctive investment management capabilities, we provide a wide range of investment strategies and vehicles to our clients around the world. If you're looking for challenging work, intelligent colleagues, and exposure across a global footprint, come explore your potential at Invesco.

**What’s in it for you?**
=========================

Our people are at the very core of our success. Invesco employees get more out of life through our comprehensive compensation and benefit offerings including:

* Flexible paid time off
* Hybrid work schedule
* 401(K) matching of 100% up to the first 6% with a discretionary supplemental contribution
* Health & wellbeing benefits
* Parental Leave benefits
* Employee stock purchase plan

**Job Description**
===================

Experience & Qualifications

* 1+ years of experience in a buy-side or sell-side equity research role covering the financials sector, with experience analyzing companies such as banks, insurance companies, asset managers, capital markets firms, or other financial institutions.
* Strong financial modeling, valuation, accounting, and fundamental research capabilities.
* Ability to analyze key financial-sector drivers, including interest rates, credit quality, capital levels, margins, profitability, and regulatory considerations.
* Demonstrated interest in long-term, fundamental investing and developing differentiated investment views.
* Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in finance, economics, accounting, business, or a related field.
* CFA designation or demonstrated progress toward completing the CFA program preferred.
* MBA or other relevant graduate degree is a plus.

Key Investment & Commercial Responsibilities

* Rigorous Company Analysis: Conduct fundamental research on companies within the financials sector, including financial statement analysis, forecasting, valuation, competitive positioning, management quality, and industry dynamics.
* Financial Modeling & Valuation: Build and maintain detailed financial models and evaluate companies using appropriate valuation methodologies and sector-specific metrics.
* Fact-Based Investment Judgment: Analyze financial, industry, economic, and market information to develop evidence-based conclusions. Identify the key drivers of investment performance and adjust views as facts and market conditions evolve.
* Investment Idea Development: Develop and communicate investment recommendations that clearly define the investment thesis, valuation, catalysts, risk/reward, key risks, and factors that could change the investment view.
* Company & Industry Engagement: Engage with company management teams, sell-side analysts, industry experts, and other market participants to deepen research, test assumptions, and develop differentiated perspectives.
* Sector & Macro Perspective: Evaluate how factors such as interest rates, credit cycles, economic conditions, regulation, capital requirements, and market activity may affect individual companies and the broader financials sector.
* Investment Tools & Technology: Demonstrate proficiency with relevant investment and research tools, including Bloomberg, financial research platforms, Microsoft Office, and relevant AI-enabled research tools.

* Successful investors on our Fundamental Equities team combine conviction with curiosity, challenge with collaboration, and independence with humility.

* Sound Judgment & Intellectual Flexibility: Maintain conviction when supported by evidence while remaining willing to reassess conclusions when new information emerges.
* Collaboration & Trusted Relationships: Build effective relationships across the investment team and with company management, analysts, brokers, and other industry participants.
* Integrity & Enterprise Awareness: Understand the broader client, operational, reputational, legal, regulatory, and fiduciary considerations associated with investment decisions and consistently support the firm’s Compliance Culture.

626353efd1e1f7ab.description:
### **Description**

This is an analyst role within the Market Analysis team, with a particular focus on developing insight into the law firm mid-market and regional legal markets. Operating within the wider team structure, the role involves analyzing data from multiple sources, including proprietary datasets, to develop structured insights and produce clear, data-driven content outputs for a senior professional audience. The analyst will be responsible for driving critical insights and analysis for the legal industry.

  

### **Key Responsibilities**

Analysis and written output

* Develop data-led content for Law.com and Law.com Compass, contributing analysis and findings from proprietary datasets on law firms and legal markets to inform law firm leadership audiences
* Apply structured data analysis to examine firm performance, market trends, and competitive dynamics, producing insights that underpin content outputs
* Identify patterns, trends, and relationships in data that develop clear, actionable and evidence-based conclusions
* Produce insight-led narratives, clearly translating data analysis into written outputs
* Design high-quality data visualisations that support content outputs and make analysis and its implications actionable for law firm leadership
* Support the evolution of analytical outputs, shaping findings and formats to align with strategic priorities
* Research and data support
* Monitor the legal market on an ongoing basis, using law firm intelligence to inform analysis of market trends and competitive dynamics
* Build relationships with law firms to support market intelligence gathering, data collection, and deeper understanding of firm priorities and regional market dynamics
* Develop and apply working knowledge of Law.com Compass and its associated datasets to support analysis, insight generation, and content development
* Scope, collect, and structure market data to support content development
* Identify data gaps and contribute to shaping and sourcing new data collection initiatives
* Validate and quality-check data to ensure accuracy, consistency, and reliability for analysis
* Conduct secondary research using publicly available sources, including firm communications, market reports, and filings, to contextualize quantitative findings

Collaboration

* Work closely with the wider market analyst team on joint projects, taking ownership of defined workstreams
* Coordinate with the Law.com editorial team where analysis overlaps with or informs news coverage
* Liaise with the data and intelligence unit on data availability and survey outputs
* Build relationships with key external stakeholders to support analysis and insight development
  

  

### **Skills Knowledge and Expertise**

  

* In-depth understanding of the legal market, including law firm strategy, competitive dynamics, regional market structures, and the business of law
* Experience across business intelligence, legal journalism, or market research, ideally with exposure to professional services or law firms
* Degree in a relevant discipline, with a solid academic record
* Comfortable working with data, able to interrogate and analyze large datasets, identify trends, and synthesize findings
* Exceptional writing skills, with the ability to produce clear, well-structured, data-led outputs for a professional audience, including articles and executive-level briefings.
* Excellent verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain analysis and findings in discussions with stakeholders
* Highly organized and self-directed, with the ability to manage and prioritize multiple workstreams independently and with limited supervision
* A critical thinker with a strong interest in problem-solving, particularly in data-driven contexts
* Expertise in data visualization and analytical tools, along with a working knowledge of how AI can be applied to workflows. Advanced Microsoft Office skills (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, Teams)

**About Centellic**

Centellic stands at the center of the markets it serves, empowering organizations with indispensable data and insight to make critical decisions on growth, risk and opportunity.

Through proprietary data, deep market expertise and AI-enabled technology, our platforms are embedded in client workflows. That capability is underpinned by our events, which bring the market together to share perspective and deepen understanding of the issues shaping each sector. Together, they give organizations earlier visibility of emerging trends, and the clarity and confidence to act when decisions matter.

At Centellic, we’re a global intelligence and information services business, setting the standard for how critical business decisions are made.

**Why Centellic?**

At Centellic, we help our clients make better decisions, and our people are at the heart of that work. Every individual plays an important role in this, bringing curiosity and high standards to everything they do.

Those who thrive here take ownership, care deeply about their work and are committed to excellence. Standards are high because our people set them that way. And while we have decades of expertise, we are still growing, pushing and building something extraordinary.

Centellic’s advantage is our people and the culture we’ve created together. It’s an environment where individuality is encouraged, relationships are genuine, and there’s a strong sense of purpose in what we’re building together. Collaborative, respectful and driven, we take our work seriously without taking ourselves too seriously.

### **Benefits**

Our people are our most valuable asset, as such, we offer a wide range of benefits to help ensure that all are supported:

* 15 vacation days, 12 company holidays, three personal days, one day to volunteer at the organization of your choice, plus a day off for your birthday each year
* Choice of three Cigna health insurance plans, two dental plans, and vision coverage.
* Health Savings

37f672b3193bacf0.title: Research Analyst & Content Writer – Private Assets R&D
37f672b3193bacf0.description:
Your Team Responsibilities:

MSCI Private Assets is seeking a Research Analyst & Content Writer to join its Research & Development team. This is a hybrid research and writing role for someone who combines strong quantitative and analytical capability with excellence in financial writing and the ability to communicate complex investment insights clearly and accurately.

Embedded within the R&D team, the Content Researcher acts as the analytical bridge between MSCI's underlying research and the content delivered to clients and the market.

The person in this role owns the content function end-to-end: they interact with MSCI’s private asset data across private equity, private credit, private real assets and related closed-end structures; draft and refine commentary; and maintain the technical integrity of the published output.

This is not an editorial or marketing-content role. It requires someone comfortable working directly with quantitative data and research methodologies, capable of reproducing and interrogating analysis, and possessing the judgment to identify when conclusions require additional evidentiary support.

Your Key Ressponsibilities:

**What You’ll Do**

* **Query MSCI private assets databases** and **generate original analyses and develop data insights** relevant to clients, using AI in supervised form, working closely with the Private Assets R&D team and other subject-matter experts for methodology guidance and data validation.
* **Create clear, accurate charts and data visualizations** that communicate analytical findings to clients and the market and adhere to MSCI standards.
* **Draft commentary** **on charts, data findings, and market trends** (leveraging AI), translating quantitative analysis into clear written insights without losing precision or nuance; refine for accuracy, tone, and adherence to MSCI voice and standards.
* **Provide technical and analytical review of additional Private Assets content**, including content produced by Product and Marketing, external writers, and AI tools, validating factual accuracy and consistency with MSCI data and methodologies.
* Contribute to MSCI’s recurring publications of data-driven market insights, including original content and refreshed analyses that reflect current data and market conditions; coordinate related deliverables from the broader R&D team.
* Collaborate closely with Marketing and Communications while maintaining clear accountability for the technical and methodological integrity of R&D-supported content.
* Help establish scalable quality-control approaches as the volume of research and AI-assisted content increases.
* Manage recurring publication commitments and multiple workstreams to agreed deadlines while maintaining high standards of analytical and editorial quality.

Your skills and experience that will help you excel:

**What We’re Looking For**

* Strong quantitative and analytical skills, with the ability to interrogate datasets, reproduce analysis, and critically assess whether conclusions are supported by the underlying data, along with the intellectual curiosity and confidence to challenge assumptions.

MainStreet Advisors, an independent, Chicago-based Registered Investment Advisor, seeks a motivated Fixed Income Analyst with two to five years of relevant experience to join our growing investment team. With over $6 billion in assets under advisement, MainStreet Advisors provides investment management, portfolio construction, research, and client communication services to community bank trust and wealth management departments nationwide. Through these relationships, we help manage investment portfolios for individuals, trusts, foundations, endowments, retirement accounts, and institutional clients.

**Position Overview**

The Fixed Income Analyst will play an integral role in supporting the firm's fixed income investment strategies, portfolio management activities, and broader investment research initiatives. This position offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience across fixed income trading, taxable and tax-exempt bond portfolio construction, economic research, asset allocation, and client communications.

Working collaboratively with senior investment professionals, the successful candidate will contribute to investment decisions, support portfolio implementation, and participate in the firm's Investment Committee process. The role also provides opportunities to contribute to investment publications and engage directly with clients and prospective clients.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

· Assist with the execution, allocation, settlement, and reconciliation of fixed income transactions across client portfolios.

· Support the construction and ongoing management of taxable and tax-exempt fixed income portfolios, considering duration, credit quality, yield, sector allocation, liquidity, and client-specific investment objectives.

· Analyze individual bond securities and identify attractive investment opportunities through relative value, credit, yield curve, and spread analysis.

· Evaluate municipal bond investments, including issuer credit quality, tax-equivalent yields, and state-specific tax considerations.

· Monitor portfolio characteristics, maturity schedules, cash flows, and risk exposures to identify rebalancing opportunities and investment recommendations.

· Coordinate with the trading team, custodians, and other service providers to ensure accurate and timely trade processing and settlement.

**Investment Research**

· Monitor economic developments, monetary policy, interest rate trends, and fixed income market conditions to identify investment opportunities and risks.

· Contribute to the firm's strategic and tactical asset allocation discussions, including research on capital market assumptions, interest rate expectations, and relative attractiveness across asset classes.

· Participate in Investment Committee meetings and relevant subcommittees, including Fixed Income and Asset Allocation, by preparing research, analysis, and investment recommendations.

· Utilize Bloomberg, Excel, and other investment research platforms to support portfolio analytics, security selection, and risk management.

· Contribute to the development of written investment commentary, market outlooks, research publications, and other client-facing educational and marketing materials.

· Prepare investment reports, portfolio analyses, presentations, and supporting materials for internal discussions, client meetings, and prospective client presentations.

· Participate in client and prospect calls alongside senior investment professionals, providing insights on fixed income markets, portfolio positioning, and investment strategy.

· Collaborate with the broader investment team to communicate investment views and recommendations clearly and effectively.

**Qualifications and Skills**

· Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, or a related field.

· 2–5 years of relevant experience in investment management, fixed income research, portfolio management, trading, or a related field preferred.

· Progress toward the Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) designation preferred.

· Working knowledge of fixed income securities, bond mathematics, credit analysis, and portfolio construction principles.

· Familiarity with taxable and tax-exempt fixed income markets, including corporate and municipal bonds.

· Strong analytical and quantitative skills, including proficiency in Microsoft Excel.

· Experience with Bloomberg or similar investment research and analytics platforms preferred.

· Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex investment concepts clearly and concisely.

· Strong attention to detail, particularly in trading, portfolio analytics, and investment reporting.

· Intellectual curiosity and a genuine interest in financial markets, economics, and investment management.

Our employees are our greatest asset. We have spent years building a team of talented, dedicated technologists, data-driven traders, and expert leaders with an emphasis on our core pillars:People, Process, Trading Edge, and Technology. Simplex is an in-office organization, helping to foster a collaborative and communicative culture.

**Career Description**

We’re hiring an Algorithmic Trader focused on CME equity index futures. You’ll build and run short-horizon strategies at microsecond-to-second timescales: turning full-depth order book data into predictive signals, designing passive market-making logic for ES, and working with our C++ and FPGA developers to get your ideas into production. This role suits someone who has traded or researched ES/NQ in a low-latency environment and enjoys taking an idea from raw market data to live trading.

**What you will be doing**

* Research and build short-horizon (microsecond to second) price-prediction signals for CME equity index futures from full-depth order book and trade data: order aggressiveness, queue position, cancels, icebergs, and leads from related futures and cash equities.
* Own the signal pipeline end to end: packet-capture data, feature design, sampling, model fitting (linear and tree-based), pruning, out-of-sample simulation, and deployment with C++ and FPGA developers.
* Design and tune a passive ES market-making strategy: level joining, queue-priority value, order spacing, cancel/replace timing, exchange messaging limits, and protective pulls when latency or connectivity degrades.
* Model the matching engine: turn fill latency and book state into estimates of how many levels traded and future price changes, then use this information to move quotes, purge, and take liquidity in futures, index options, and equities.
* Measure and improve latency: profile order paths in microseconds, reconcile wireless and fiber timestamps across data centers, compare vendor signal feeds, and quantify misses against exchange reports.
* Write specs for developers, verify their output against your own calculations, and find bugs in production data and pricing pipelines.

Skills and experience

* 2+ years trading or researching CME equity index futures (ES/NQ) at a proprietary trading firm with sub-millisecond systems.
* Hands-on experience with CME MDP 3.0 order-by-order market data: book building, queue-position tracking, iceberg and self-match-prevention inference, matching-engine latency behavior.
* Built microprice or alpha models that ran live at microsecond horizons. Fluent in lead/lag analysis, half-lives, markouts, and adverse selection.
* Passive quoting experience on FIFO futures markets: queue value, join and cancel logic, messaging-efficiency constraints, mass-quote protections.
* Python research stack (polars or pandas, numpy, gradient-boosted trees, SQL). Reads C++. Has worked alongside FPGA or low-latency engineers.
* Bonus: index basis and roll (cash, futures, BTIC), SPX options, or microwave network latency.

**Fitch Ratings is currently seeking Associate Analysts based out of our Chicago office.**

  

Fitch Ratings is a leading provider of credit ratings, commentary, and research. The additional context, perspective, and insights we provide help investors to make important credit judgments with confidence.

  

**What We Offer:**

As an Associate Analyst, you’ll be assigned to a specific Fitch Ratings product group and provided roles and responsibilities that fully immerse you in the credit rating process.

At Fitch, you will receive the training to develop a high level of service to investors and issuers and a team-oriented approach to ratings analysis. Day to day work will include evaluating risk, participation in rating committees, drafting rating affirmations, and writing research reports.

**Corporate Ratings**

The group's analytical methodology addresses the legal, regulatory and market environments in over 100 countries in which Fitch Ratings operates, with particular emphasis on debt structure.

  

**Financial Institutions**

Fitch’s financial institutions’ coverage includes not only banks but also finance and leasing companies, securities firms, and asset management organizations. In addition, the group supports dedicated teams for rating specialized securities such as covered bonds.

Fitch Ratings creates value beyond the rating by bringing an informed perspective to the U.S. Public Finance sector. Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago 

Are you a curious, quantitatively skilled recent graduate who wants to understand how economic research informs real-world policy? Join the Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago’s Research Assistant Program and work alongside economists and researchers on important questions facing the economy, financial markets, businesses, and households.

As a Research Assistant, you will gain hands-on experience across the research process, including managing data, conducting econometric analysis, answering economic questions, and communicating results through compelling charts, written analysis, and presentations. You will contribute to both long-term research and timely policy analysis while building the technical and analytical skills needed for a successful career in economics.

This is a two-year opportunity designed for recent graduates who want to deepen their research capabilities, explore the field of economics, and prepare for the next stage of their careers. 

 What You’ll Do 
 Research Assistants work closely with economists and research staff across a range of economic and policy areas, including macroeconomics, microeconomics, finance, and regional economics.
 Responsibilities include:
 Collecting, cleaning, managing, and analyzing economic and financial data.
 Conducting statistical and econometric analysis and developing research code using tools such as Stata, R, Python, and MATLAB.
 Conducting literature reviews and synthesizing academic and policy research.
 Preparing charts, tables, written analysis, presentations, and briefing materials.
 Supporting research papers, publications, and time-sensitive policy analysis.
 Collaborating with economists, researchers, and other Research Assistants across projects.

 Your Development 
 The Research Assistant Program provides opportunities to develop your research, technical, and professional skills through:
 Training in programming, econometrics, data analysis, and research tools.
 Research seminars featuring Chicago Fed economists and visiting scholars.
 Workshops, conferences, coursework, and other learning opportunities.
 Mentorship and professional development focused on graduate study and career planning.
 Building relationships across the Federal Reserve and broader research community.
 The Research Assistant Program is designed to be an important step in your career. RAs pursue futures in either graduate studies of economics, public policy, finance, law, and data science or continue with careers across government, academia, and industry.

 Who We’re Looking For 
 We seek candidates with:

Company 
Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago 

The Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago is recognized as one of the most influential, trusted and prestigious financial institutions in the world. We serve the Seventh District encompassing Iowa and most of Illinois, Indiana, Michigan, and Wisconsin, and is one of the 12 regional Reserve Banks in the United States. Together with the Board of Governors in Washington, D.C., the 12 Banks constitute the nation’s central bank. 

 JOB DESCRIPTION: 
 The Economic Research Internship offers a number of summer research opportunities across each of our departmental teams, inclusive of – but not limited to:  
 Macroeconomics
 Microeconomics
 Financial Economics
 Community Development
 Regional Research

 This program provides students with the opportunity to gain valuable research experience, network with peers in the field, and to work side-by-side with our economists and research assistants to support research and policy work. The program is designed to help students further develop quantitative analysis, critical thinking, and writing skills throughout the summer.

 Summer projects typically ask interns to:
 Support economists in their basic and applied research – inclusive of collecting data, conducting moderately complex statistical analysis, and organizing the presentation of results
 Assist economists with their research and analysis of policy issues and events
 Prepare a variety of charts, tables, and descriptive text for staff economists and department management.

 INTERNSHIP PROGRAM DETAILS: 
 The Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago Summer Intern Program is a paid internship that is open to undergraduate, graduate and PHD students.  It begins in June and continues for 12 consecutive weeks. Interns work 40 hours per week and are assigned to one department. 

 These internships are ideal for students looking to build their research portfolios, who have a potential interest in graduate school, or who are considering applying for the Chicago Fed’s Research Assistant program after graduation. Economic Research Interns are given priority consideration for 2028 RA openings providing positive recommendations regarding performance throughout their internship experience.

 Currently pursuing at least a Bachelor’s degree, graduating Fall 2027 or later, in economics, finance, or related field (e.g. statistics, computer science, mathematics, etc.)

 Some exposure and experience using data/programming languages (e.g. Stata, R, Python, MATLAB, ArcGIS, etc.)

3fc054c430ed7391.title: Loan Syndicate & Sales Trading Associate
3fc054c430ed7391.description:
**Excited to grow your career?**
================================

BBVA is a global company with more than 160 years of history that operates in more than 25 countries where we serve more than 80 million customers. We are more than 121,000 professionals working in multidisciplinary teams with profiles as diverse as financiers, legal experts, data scientists, developers, engineers and designers.

**About the job:**
==================

**Summary of Responsibilities:**

Help the efforts of the LATAM Loan Syndicate Sales & Trading team (“LSS&T”), which focuses on the underwriting, distribution and trading of syndicated loans in the primary and secondary markets, focused on LATAM Corporate Loans, Project Finance and Infrastructure, and Real Estate. LSS&T works jointly with the teams responsible for the origination, structuring and negotiation of syndicated loans and other credit and portfolio management functions. This role is critical in the continued development of BBVA as an active Lead Arranger and Bookrunner on loan transactions in the LATAM market.

  

LSS&T, in its Syndicate role, is an analytical and advisory function facilitating information flow and decision making regarding the marketability of loans. Loan Syndicate analyzes the loan markets, evaluates financing proposals and recommends terms, conditions, and applicable distribution strategies.

  

For loan underwritings, Loan Syndicate manages loan market risk, generates underwriting proposals, recommends and executes approved de-risking strategies. In each case, Loan Syndicate provides a situation appropriate market risk analysis (the Loan Underwriting Assessment), including supporting data, liquidity analysis, comparable transaction analysis, an analysis of prevailing market conditions, risk mitigation strategies and the appropriate distribution strategy for achieving BBVA’s Sell-Down Target. LSS&T champions the transaction in the underwriting committee and, if sanctioned, presented for final approval also monitors all underwritings and records them in the Open Position Report.

  

In its Sales role, LSS&T acts as primary contact point between BBVA and the loan investor universe, including regional, national and foreign banks and institutional investors (asset and fund managers, insurance companies, pension funds, etc…). Responsibility includes primary distribution of loans when BBVA acts as Lead Arranger and Bookrunner, including for Corporate Loans (IG and Mid Corp), Project Finance and Infrastructure, and Real Estate. In addition, the team works closely with Loan Trading & Portfolio Management on secondary opportunities to source or divest loans for the bank’s portfolios. As well, the team assists relationship managers in sourcing primary and secondary loans that can enhance the Bank’s position with its client base and provide an entry point for prospective clients.

  

The position requires knowledge of the corporate loan market (investment and non-investment grade), the structured aka project finance and infrastructure sectors, real estate and other sectors in which BBVA is active across the Americas.

  

The general responsibilities for the role include but are not limited to the following:

  

* Help senior staff to identify underwriting opportunities across the various business lines, working closely with the coverage bankers and origination and structuring teams
* Work with these teams as well as Risk and PM to identify the appropriate level of final hold desired
* Help senior staff to formulate appropriate level of underwriting commitments and associated de-risk strategies to achieve BBVA’s desired final hold
* Help to prepare LUAs to LUC and other business and risk committees as needed
* Maintain working database of investors and ongoing contact with said investors, including with the Sales team
* Help identify investor list for transactions where BBVA is Lead Arranger / Bookrunner and formulate distribution strategy
* Support the organization and management of bank meetings and marketing events, including the preparation of the necessary marketing materials
* During distribution phases of syndications, help research and answer investor questions, prepare syndication trackers and update reports maintain deal pipeline to ensure accurate reporting of all activity and especially open underwriting positions
* Keep track and provide ongoing assessment of pricing trends across sectors and markets
* Prepare loan market commentary & analysis distributed internally on a periodic basis, ie. weekly, monthly, etc..
* Oversee the maintaining of database of loan comparables
* Work with Loan Trading and Portfolio Management on optimizing secondary loan execution for the various portfolio books within BBVA
* Regulatory and compliance obligations including proper documentation of all trades, etc..
* Monitor & support the closing of loan trades by BBVA’s Closing teams as needed
Provide periodic monitoring and reporting of underwritten positions and sell-down results, and associated economics, to Team Head and Sr. Management.  

  

**Level of Complexity and Risk Involved:**

Mid-level of complexity. Key component of the Syndicated Finance value chain supporting senior staff.Actively involved in helping to structure, price, and ultimately sell underwritten loans for the Bank. Must have knowledge of multiple loan markets and investor types in Latin America, including Corporate and Mid-Corporate credits, Real Estate and PF and Infrastructure, and understand best practices in the market, including trends in sustainable financing.

  

**Skills, knowledge, and abilities/competencies** :

* Degree in Economics, Accounting, Finance or related field. MBA a plus.
* 3 to 5 years of experience including roles in either loan syndicate or syndicated finance
* Knowledge of Corporate and Mid-Corporate, Project and Infrastructure finance, and Real Estate Latam loan markets
* Track record of underwriting and successfully syndicating transactions

**About the job**
-----------------

Community Investment Management (CIM) is looking for an Investment Analyst to join our team. CIM is a global institutional impact investment manager that provides strategic debt funding to scale and demonstrate responsible innovation in lending to underserved borrowers in the United States and emerging markets. Our work aims to advance financial inclusion by partnering with select tech-enabled lending partners, improve financial health and drive widespread adoption of such fintech innovation by the financial mainstream.

**Position Summary**

We are looking for an Investment Analyst to join our U.S. Investment Team in New York City. The position will involve occasional travel to existing and prospective fintech partners. The Investment Analyst will contribute to all aspects of CIM’s work, establishing CIM as the leading credit provider for fintech lending products and platforms in our target markets. A passion for impact at scale, strong analytical skills, and comfort with a high degree of autonomy in a collaborative, global organization are essential for success in this role.

**Responsibilities will include:**

* Conduct deal-specific diligence, including financial and credit analysis on new and existing investments. Build detailed models to evaluate investment performance across a range of scenarios.
* Support the monitoring of existing investments with periodic analytical reviews and direct portfolio company engagement.
* Synthesize findings, develop analytical perspectives with limited information, create detailed investment memos, and make recommendations to the team.
* Support the team in investment structuring, negotiation, documentation, and execution.
* Assist in building new investment theses by analyzing and assessing new markets and fintech verticals and closely monitor the competitive and regulatory landscapes across fintech sectors.
* Assist with monthly/quarterly portfolio reporting requirements
* Work closely with the teams in San Francisco, Latin America, Asia and Europe to facilitate investor reporting, audits, risk reporting and technology coordination.

**The ideal candidate:**

* Passionate about social impact, relentlessly inquisitive about identifying emerging trends, and constructively obsessed about assessing the best emerging teams and companies.
* 2-4 years of previous work experience, with a background in fintech, debt financing, or structured products.
* Strong analytical skills, attention to detail and expertise in building and assessing financial models.
* Comfortable communicating one’s opinion clearly and effectively in writing and in team discussions.
* Excited to work in a small, fluid, ambitious, and highly collaborative global team with a high degree of autonomy, self-motivation, and discipline.
* Strong interpersonal skills, collaborative mindset, intrinsically curious, self-starter, and an exceptional work ethic.
* Knowledge of other languages a plus.
* Experience manipulating and handling large datasets in Python/R/SQL

**Compensation:**

For this position, we offer a competitive base salary in the range of $100,000 to $125,000 depending on qualifications and experience. In addition to the base salary employees are offered a comprehensive benefits package, including health, dental, and retirement plans and are eligible for discretionary performance-based bonuses.

**Our Values**

1. Appreciate every voice and cultivate constructive dissidence

We believe seeing things differently is a key strength

2. Encourage each other to take chances

We believe that people produce their best ideas when they feel comfortable putting themselves out there

3. Stay humble and intellectually curious

We believe that remembering that we all are deeply flawed enables a learning mindset which empowers us to discover new solutions and grow

4. Seek alignment

We believe that we are best set up for success when we share the same goals with our partners

5. Find a better way

We believe that we can figure out any problem with enough persistence and creativity, diversity, equity, and inclusion are directly aligned with our core values. We know that a diverse workforce allows us to see problems in more nuanced ways, building the thought leadership needed to have outsized positive impact on the world. We actively recruit, develop, and retain people from a diverse candidate pool. We strongly encourage women, people of color, lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer and non-binary people, veterans, parents, and individuals with disabilities to apply. CIM is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes everyone to our team. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace and equal opportunity for all applicants, as well as employees. Qualified applicants with prior criminal records will be considered for employment consistent with federal, state, and local laws, including but not limited to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

350883675d510fb2.description:
About Rockefeller Capital Management:

Rockefeller Capital Management was established in 2018 as a leading independent financial advisory services firm. Originally founded in 1882 as the family office of John D. Rockefeller, the Firm has evolved to offer strategic advice to ultra- and high-net-worth individuals and families, institutions, and corporations from offices in 37 markets throughout the United States, as well as an office in London. The Firm oversees $236 billion in client assets as of September 30, 2026.

Position:

A top-ranked Private Advisor team within our Rockefeller Global Family Office business unit, focused on serving entrepreneurs, business owners, and high-net-worth families, is seeking a motivated individual to join its growing team as a Wealth Management Analyst. The Wealth Management Analyst will partner closely with Private Advisor team members and interact directly with high-net-worth clients and prospects. This role combines client service, practice management, business development support, marketing coordination, performance reporting and investment-related analysis. The ideal candidate is proactive, detail-oriented, and highly organized, with strong communication and problem-solving skills. They should also be eager to learn and leverage emerging technologies, including AI, to improve team efficiency and the client experience.

Responsibilities:

* Handle operational aspects of client accounts including reporting on account holdings and investment performance, posting daily cash activity, and entering trade instructions.
* Generate expense reports for submission using Concur.
* Process new accounts and account maintenance, by obtaining all necessary approvals and ensuring all client documentation is returned, completed and approved.
* Process all client cashiering requests (money market redemptions, wires, checks, journals, check deposits, etc.).
* Support marketing and business development efforts, including client seminars and events.
* Review daily activity and reconcile current client activity, funds transfers and previous day’s activity and trades against various clearing firm systems to ensure accuracy.
* Attend client meetings as necessary and present client performance.
* Attend prospect calls and meetings; take detailed notes, prepare draft follow-up communications, and research and track action items through completion.
* Review firm marketing materials and thought leadership to identify and share relevant content with prospects and clients on a monthly basis.
* Proactively maintain the prospect and client database by adding new contacts, updating records, and ensuring information remains accurate and current.
* Prepare materials for client and prospect meetings, including agendas, presentations, reports, background research, and follow-up items.
* Support the team with asset allocation analysis and related investment materials.
* Create, review, and run client performance reports, ensuring information is complete, accurate, and ready for advisor and client use.

**ABOUT SOTHEBY'S**

Established in 1744, Sotheby's promotes access and ownership of exceptional art and luxury objects through auctions, private sales and retail. Our deep expertise across 70 selling categories is supported by a leading technology platform and a global network of specialists spanning 40 countries. Selling categories include Contemporary Art, Modern and Impressionist Art, Old Masters, Chinese Works of Art, Jewelry, Watches, Wine and Spirits and Design, as well as collectible cars and real estate through RM Sotheby's and Concierge. Sotheby's Financial Services is a leading art lender and provides capital solutions for collectors around the world, having originated more than $12 billion in loans since its inception. Sotheby's new global headquarters is now open at the iconic Breuer building at 945 Madison Avenue in New York City.

**THE ROLE**

Sotheby's Client Strategy team develops and implements strategies around existing clients and gathers intelligence on key high net worth individuals in order to generate commercial opportunities. Partnering with areas of the business including Specialist Departments, Regional Offices, Marketing, Business Intelligence, Special Events, and other key business units, this team is responsible for spearheading initiatives to maximize Sotheby's reach within its existing and prospective client base.

The Client Strategy Analyst will work in tandem with Client Strategists to contribute to short-, mid- and long-term strategic initiatives. The responsibilities include coordinating global projects, executing top client strategies, data analysis and data maintenance, cross-departmental prospecting research, and new client identification . The Analyst will play a key role in leveraging both external and internal client data to drive business initiatives, including (but not limited to):

65c6919573302c8f.description:
**Position Title:** Pipeline Intelligence Analyst

**Location:** 633 3 rd Ave, New York, NY 10017

**Reports to:** Director of Strategic Intelligence and Pipeline

**Compensation** : $82,000 - $92,000/Yr ( *based on experience and qualifications* )

**About The Fedcap Group**

For more than 90 years, Fedcap has been turning possibility into reality. As a global nonprofit serving more than 335,000 people each year across the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and Australia, we open doors to economic mobility through innovative, evidence-based solutions in education, workforce development, health, and economic development. Join us and experience The Power of Possible, where your work creates real opportunities for people facing barriers to economic well-being and helps build stronger communities every day.

**Position Summary**
--------------------

Reporting to the Director of Strategic Intelligence and Pipeline, the Pipeline Intelligence Analyst is responsible for maintaining a trusted enterprise pipeline and producing the analysis required to manage growth performance, opportunity priorities and portfolio risk.

The postholder will drive CRM discipline, data quality, reporting and dashboarding, while providing insight on conversion, must-win priorities, recompete exposure, concentration and pipeline risk. The role will turn pipeline data into clear management information that supports governance, financial alignment and action.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Pipeline Data Quality & CRM Discipline**
------------------------------------------

Maintain a complete, accurate and trusted enterprise pipeline by applying agreed data, stage and governance standards. Work directly with opportunity owners to resolve gaps and ensure records reflect the current position.

* Monitor Salesforce and associated pipeline records for completeness, accuracy, currency and consistency.
* Validate opportunity value, stage, timing, probability, ownership, next steps and supporting evidence.
* Follow up missing or overdue updates with opportunity owners and track resolution of data-quality issues.
* Apply agreed pipeline definitions, entry and exit criteria and mandatory data standards.
* Produce data-quality reports and identify recurring control or adoption issues.

**Pipeline Reporting & Dashboards**
-----------------------------------

Produce clear, reliable management information that gives leaders visibility of pipeline value, maturity, movement and risk. Maintain dashboards and reporting packs that support action and decision-making.

* Prepare regular pipeline dashboards, KPI reports, review packs and executive summaries.
* Report pipeline value by stage, geography, service line, customer, owner and expected decision date.
* Highlight material movements, stalled opportunities, overdue actions and changes in assumptions.
* Maintain consistent reporting logic, definitions and reconciliations across reports.
* Improve reporting efficiency through appropriate dashboarding, automation and standard templates.

**Pipeline Reviews & Governance Support**
-----------------------------------------

Coordinate the information and analysis required for effective pipeline governance. Ensure review forums have accurate records, clear actions and timely follow-through.

* Prepare agendas, analysis and opportunity information for pipeline and portfolio reviews.
* Identify records that do not meet qualification, evidence or stage-gate requirements.
* Capture decisions, actions, owners and deadlines arising from governance reviews.
* Monitor agreed actions and escalate unresolved data or process issues to the Director.
* Maintain the governance calendar and supporting documentation.

**Prioritization & Portfolio Analysis**
---------------------------------------

Provide analysis that supports evidence-based opportunity prioritization and must-win management. Help leaders understand pipeline balance, resource implications and alignment with growth strategy.

* Maintain prioritization scores, must-win reporting and portfolio views using agreed criteria.
* Analyze pipeline balance across sectors, commissioners, territories, service lines and maturity stages.
* Identify concentration, diversification and coverage trends within the opportunity portfolio.
* Prepare analytical inputs for resource allocation and investment discussions.
* Track whether priority opportunities continue to meet the evidence required for their status.

**Conversion, Win/Loss & Performance Insight**
----------------------------------------------

Track how opportunities progress through the lifecycle and identify where conversion is improving or weakening. Convert performance data into practical insight for governance and continuous improvement.

* Calculate and monitor stage conversion, win rates, pipeline velocity and ageing using agreed definitions.
* Analyze bottlenecks, stalled opportunities and patterns in progression or attrition.
* Support win/loss reviews by preparing data, trends and opportunity histories.
* Compare performance across relevant portfolio dimensions without overstating conclusions.
* Produce concise recommendations and follow-up measures arising from analysis.

**Recompete, Concentration & Pipeline Risk Insight**
----------------------------------------------------

Maintain visibility of contract expiry, recompete exposure, concentration and other risks that may affect future growth. Provide early warning of coverage gaps and changes that require management action.

* Maintain the recompete and contract-expiry view and reconcile it with the active pipeline.
* Monitor pipeline maturity, probability, timing, dependencies and key risk indicators.
* Analyze exposure by commissioner, funder, contract, market, geography and service line.
* Identify future revenue gaps, weak pipeline coverage and material changes in portfolio risk.
* Support scenario and mitigation analysis with Finance, Growth and Opportunity Management.

*

**Who are we?**
===============

Howden is a global insurance group with employee ownership at its heart. Together, we have pushed the boundaries of insurance. We are united by a shared passion and no-limits mindset, and our strength lies in our ability to collaborate as a powerful international team comprised of 24,000 employees spanning over 56 countries.

People join Howden for many different reasons, but they stay for the same one: our culture. It’s what sets us apart, and the reason our employees have been turning down headhunters for years. Whatever your priorities – work / life balance, career progression, sustainability, volunteering – you’ll find like-minded people driving change at Howden.

**Location:** New York, NY

**Start date:** Summer 2027

**Working structure:** Hybrid

**Application deadline:** Monday, December 21st

  

**The Program**

Our 12-month Program is designed to provide early career professionals with a comprehensive introduction to the insurance industry and the opportunity to develop the technical, commercial, and relationship-building skills needed for a successful career.

As an Analyst on our Korean Practice team you'll complete rotations across:

* **Broking**
* **Sales**
* **Account Management**

Our Korea team supports Korean businesses and organizations with international operations, helping them navigate insurance requirements across different markets. The team combines specialist knowledge of Korean business practices with access to global insurance markets to develop solutions that address clients' commercial, operational, and cross-border risks.

Throughout the program, you'll remain within your assigned business line, allowing you to build specialist knowledge of the industry, its clients, and the unique risks and challenges they face, while experiencing how different functions work together to deliver solutions.

You'll work alongside experienced professionals, contribute to meaningful client work, and develop the technical, commercial, and relationship-building skills needed to build a successful career in insurance.

**What you'll be doing**

* Develop an understanding of how insurance brokers assess risk, engage with insurance markets, and negotiate coverage solutions for clients.
* Learn how we develop new business opportunities, build relationships with prospective clients, and communicate the value of our insurance solutions.
* Explore how we maintain and develop client relationships, coordinate insurance services, and deliver an exceptional client experience.

**What are we looking for?**

You don't need previous insurance experience or technical knowledge - we'll provide the training and support to help you succeed.

We're looking for students graduating with a bachelor's degree between December 2026 and May 2027 from any degree discipline who are excited to learn, curious about business, and interested in understanding how organizations manage risk and navigate complex challenges.

You'll thrive in this role if you are:

* Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree, with an expected graduation date between December 2026 and May 2027.

* On track to achieve, or have achieved, a cumulative GPA of 3.2 or above.
* Speak fluent Korean
* Curious, proactive, and eager to learn new concepts and skills.
* Adaptable and comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
* A strong communicator who enjoys building relationships and collaborating with others.
* Motivated to take ownership of your work and contribute to team success.
* A problem-solver who approaches challenges with a positive, solutions-focused mindset.
* Resilient, organized, and able to manage multiple priorities effectively.

To be eligible for this program, you must have unrestricted authorization to work in the United States.

**Compensation and Benefits**

The expected base salary range for this role is $85,000; actual base salary will be determined based on factors including candidate experience and work location. This role is classified as non-exempt under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA).

In addition to a competitive base salary, employees are eligible to receive a discretionary bonus. Howden also offers a variety of benefits and programs, subject to eligibility, including:

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance, including healthcare savings and reimbursement accounts
* 401(k) retirement plan
* Flexible Paid Time Off and paid parental leave
* Life and Disability insurance

===============================

A career that you define. At Howden, we value diversity – there is no one Howden type. Instead, we’re looking for individuals who share the same values as us:

* Our successes have all come from someone brave enough to try something new
* We support each other in the small everyday moments and the bigger challenges
* We are determined to make a positive difference at work and beyond

**Reasonable adjustments**
==========================

We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations at Howden to ensure that our positions align well with your needs. Besides the usual adjustments such as software, IT, and office setups, we can also accommodate other changes such as flexible hours\* or hybrid working\*.

If you're excited by this role but have some doubts about whether it’s the right fit for you, send us your application – if your profile fits the role’s criteria, we will be in touch to assist in helping to get you set up with any reasonable adjustments you may require.

**Preferred**

* Demonstrated ability to remain composed in a high-pressure, deadline-driven environment.

* Flexible, dependable, and collaborative approach to working with clients and internal partners.
* Initiative in identifying issues, recommending practical solutions, and independently developing new skills and knowledge.

**Core Competencies**

* Operational execution

* Accuracy and attention to detail

Evercore is seeking a highly motivated Associate Corporate Controller to join the Finance team, reporting to the Lead Controller – Corporate Functions. The successful candidate will contribute to the groups’ budgeting, forecasting, and monthly/quarterly close processes, and will support financial decision-making and strategic planning across the Global Corporate Group. This role would also be tasked with preparing and maintaining supporting schedules that contribute to the Firm’s quarterly and annual public reporting.

  
  

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Financial Reporting and Analysis:**

* Reconcile third party vendor usage to verify accuracy of invoicing process
* Assist in preparation of management presentation materials for monthly and quarterly review
* Collaborate cross-functionally with global corporate groups – specifically RESO, Human Capital Group, and Communications & Event Marketing – to support key business initiatives through financial reporting, analysis, and presentation
  + Support the preparation and coordination of the annual non-compensation budget process
  + Assist in consolidating the monthly corporate group accrual process
  + Prepare the consolidated monthly non-compensation analysis package, partnering with peers to investigate and resolve key variances

**Accounting Operations:**

* Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close processes, ensuring they are completed on time and accurately
* Support the company’s ASC 842 lease accounting process, including lease classification, right-of-use assets and liabilities, journal entries, reconciliations, lease schedules, and financial disclosures, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely reporting

* Collaborate closely with the Accounts Payable team to ensure accurate invoice processing, including reviewing entries during month-end close, and initiating reclassifications or updates as needed

* Collaborate with Finance teams in US and Europe to meet operational targets and deliver ad-hoc projects, as necessary

**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Be the voice that brings Quantitative Investment Strategies (QIS) to life for financial advisors and institutional clients. You'll help translate markets and structuring into clear, actionable solutions that drive real client outcomes.

**Job summary**

As an Associate in Sales (Structured Investments), you will serve as a highly client-facing sales resource responsible for building and sustaining an active engagement cadence with broker-dealers, banks, RIAs, insurance clients, and ETF issuers, with frequent day-to-day interaction with financial advisors. In close partnership with third-party wholesaling partners, you will educate, position, and drive adoption of QIS solutions delivered through multiple product wrappers. You will coordinate with internal partners, including Trading and Structuring, to provide QIS updates, product positioning support, implementation support, and timely content in service of client outcomes. You will also develop a practical understanding of structured note construction by engaging directly with pricing models and modeling frameworks to construct and iterate indicative structures (terms, payoffs, scenarios, and tradeoffs) for client discussions.

**Job responsibilities**

* Maintain an active coverage and engagement cadence with financial advisors and institutional partners across broker-dealers, banks, RIAs, insurance clients, and ETF issuers.
* Partner with third-party wholesaling partners to plan outreach, prepare for meetings, deliver training sessions, and execute follow-ups that progress opportunities from education through adoption.
* Drive consultative sales conversations by translating QIS and structured investment characteristics into clear, client-relevant messaging tailored to audience and market context.
* Coordinate closely with Trading and Structuring to deliver timely QIS/product updates, respond to client questions, and support implementation and ongoing client experience.
* Support the construction and positioning of QIS-linked structured investments via indicative pricing, structure design, term iteration, and scenario analysis.
* Engage directly with pricing models and modeling frameworks to build and evaluate indicative terms, payoff profiles, scenarios, and wrapper-driven tradeoffs for client discussions.
* Maintain pipeline discipline and execution rigor, including tracking next steps, coordinating readiness/approvals, and gathering feedback to improve content and positioning.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* FINRA Series 7 and Series 63 are required; candidates must already hold them or obtain them if not currently licensed.
* Demonstrated ability to build relationships and engage credibly with financial advisors and institutional partners through frequent meetings, training, and follow-up.
* Strong consultative communication skills with the ability to educate, influence, and tailor messaging to different audiences.
* Foundational derivatives knowledge, or demonstrated aptitude, relevant to structured products, including comfort with option-based payoff mechanics and client-relevant tradeoffs.
* Practical ability, or strong aptitude, to work directly with pricing models/modeling frameworks to construct and iterate indicative structures and scenarios.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with disciplined follow-through in a high-urgency environment.
* Willingness and ability to travel frequently for client and advisor engagement.

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Prior experience distributing QIS, systematic strategies, or structured investments to advisor and institutional channels.
* Experience delivering advisor education, including teach-ins, product deep-dives, and training programs, and producing advisor-facing materials.
* Familiarity with multiple delivery “wrappers” (e.g., structured notes, ETFs, insurance-linked solutions) and how wrapper constraints affect design and positioning.
* Demonstrated ability to partner effectively across Trading/Structuring and broader stakeholders to deliver implementation-ready outcomes.

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Established in 2012, Faropoint is a pure play RE fund manager focusing on the last mile industrial sector. **About Middle River Power**

Middle River Power (MRP) is a Chicago-based power generation company that owns and operates more than 8 GW of natural gas, coal, battery storage, and solar generation assets across the United States. We are committed to safe, reliable, and efficient operations.

  

We are a collaborative, fast-paced organization that values ownership, curiosity, adaptability, and creative problem-solving. Our people challenge the status quo, communicate openly, and work together to deliver results.

  

**Position Summary**

The Analyst, Finance & Asset Strategy supports financial analysis, planning, and performance tracking for the Company’s portfolio of power generation assets. The position builds and maintains asset-level financial models, prepares budgets, forecasts, and variance analyses, and turns operating and financial data into clear reporting for the Finance and Asset Strategy team, asset managers, and senior management.

The Analyst works closely with Accounting, Commercial, Operations, and plant teams to gather and validate data, and supports capital, commercial, and portfolio decisions, including acquisitions and financings. This position may be based in Houston, Texas or Chicago, Illinois.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Build, update, and maintain asset-level financial models that integrate operating, commercial, capital, market, and contractual assumptions.
* Support annual budgets, monthly and quarterly forecasts, and long-range plans for assigned power generation assets.
* Prepare budget-to-actual and variance analyses, identify key performance drivers, and summarize findings for the Finance and Asset Strategy team and asset managers.
* Track asset operating and financial metrics, including availability, generation, revenue, operating and maintenance costs, capital spend, and cash flows.
* Analyze capital projects, outages, contract changes, and commercial opportunities to support investment and operating decisions.
* Prepare dashboards, management reports, and presentation materials for senior management, investors, lenders, and other stakeholders.
* Gather and validate data from Accounting, Commercial, Operations, and plant teams to ensure forecasts and analyses are complete and accurate.
* Support acquisitions, integrations, financings, and portfolio initiatives through data gathering, diligence support, and financial analysis.
* Maintain organized models, documentation, and supporting files, and identify opportunities to improve data quality, standardization, and automation.
* Perform other related duties and special projects consistent with the position’s responsibilities.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, economics, business, engineering, or a related field.
* At least 1 to 3 years of experience in financial analysis, financial planning and analysis, asset management, project finance, investment banking, or a related analytical role.
* Working knowledge of financial modeling, budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and strong proficiency in PowerPoint.
* Ability to work with large data sets and reconcile information from multiple sources accurately.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to summarize analysis for non-finance audiences.
* Strong attention to detail, organization, and ability to manage multiple deadlines.

**Benefits and Perks**

  

MRP offers a comprehensive benefits package, including:

* Medical, dental, and vision: 90% employer-funded coverage for employees and families

* HSA/FSA options: Including employer HSA contributions

* Paid time off: PTO, company holidays, and paid parental leave

* Retirement: 401(k) with company match up to 4%

* Wellness: Employee assistance and wellness resources
